title: Experienced YouTube Video Editor + Thumbnail Designer Wanted for Long-Term Work
description:
I am looking for an experienced, professional, and dependable YouTube video editor to work with me on a long-term, on-call basis.



This is not a full-time role, and hours will vary depending on when new videos are produced. Some weeks may have work, and some may not. I am looking for someone who is comfortable with flexible hours and wants to build a strong long-term working relationship with a serious content creator.



My content is primarily educational, talking-head, and informational YouTube videos, so I need an editor who understands how to keep videos engaging, polished, and easy to watch while maintaining a clean and professional style.



This is not a role for flashy, over-the-top editing. I want someone who knows how to improve pacing, clarity, and retention in a way that feels natural and polished.



What You’ll Be Doing



Video Editing



Edit talking-head YouTube videos from raw footage

Remove mistakes, pauses, filler words, and unnecessary sections

Improve pacing and flow to increase viewer retention

Add tasteful zooms, transitions, and light motion where appropriate

Add royalty-free music when needed

Include simple text, visual callouts, and graphics when useful

Follow feedback, notes, and brand standards carefully

Deliver final edits on time



Thumbnail Design



Design compelling YouTube thumbnails that are clean and clickable

Use clear text, strong visual contrast, and mobile-friendly layouts

Create thumbnails that match the tone and branding of the channel



Who I’m Looking For



At least 2 years of experience editing YouTube videos

Strong understanding of YouTube pacing, audience retention, and storytelling

Experience editing educational, commentary, or business-style content

Ability to design quality thumbnails

Strong English comprehension

Reliable communication and professional attitude

Detail-oriented and able to follow instructions closely

Open to revisions and feedback

Able to work independently and stay organized



Requirements



Reliable internet connection

Quiet home workspace

Computer/laptop that can handle editing efficiently

Willing to use TimeProof for time tracking



Position Details



Pay: $3 USD per hour

Type: On-call / as needed

Hours: Not guaranteed

Location: Remote

Payment: PayPal



How to Apply

Please include:



Links to YouTube videos you personally edited

A short summary of your experience

The editing software you use

Thumbnail examples, if available

title: YouTube Video Editor (On-Call / Long-Term)
description:
I am looking for a skilled and dependable YouTube video editor to work on an on-call / as-needed basis.



This is a long-term opportunity, but hours are not guaranteed. Work is provided only when new videos are created. This position is ideal for someone who already has other clients but wants steady, recurring editing work with a clear process and consistent standards.



What You’ll Be Editing



Talking-head educational / informational YouTube videos



Clean, professional style (not flashy or over-edited)



Focus on clarity, pacing, and viewer retention



Responsibilities



Video Editing



Cut mistakes, long pauses, and filler words



Add simple zooms, cuts, and smooth transitions



Insert royalty-free background music when needed



Follow editing notes and brand style consistently



Deliver edits on time once a video is assigned



Thumbnail Creation



Design click-worthy YouTube thumbnails



Strong contrast, readable text, clean layout



Optimized for mobile and desktop viewing



Requirements



2+ years experience editing YouTube videos



Strong understanding of YouTube pacing and retention



Experience editing educational or talking-head content



Basic graphic design skills for thumbnails



Good English comprehension



Reliable, responsive, and detail-oriented



Open to feedback and willing to improve



Able to work independently with minimal supervision



Technical Requirements



Stable wired internet connection (minimum 5 Mbps)



Quiet, distraction-free home workspace



Updated PC or laptop capable of video editing



Must be willing to use TimeProof for time tracking



Job Details



Pay: $3 USD per hour



Work Type: On-call / As needed



Hours: Not guaranteed (depends on video production)



Payment Method: PayPal



Location: Home-based 



How to Apply



Please include:



Links to YouTube videos you personally edited



A short description of your experience



Editing software you use (Premiere Pro, CapCut, Final Cut, etc.)



To confirm you read this post carefully, start your application with the word “ONCALL.”



This role is best suited for someone who values long-term cooperation, clear expectations, and consistent quality, even with flexible hours.

title: AI Growth Lead - Help Build a New AI Consulting Business - Work From Home
description:
This is not a normal job post. Please read it properly.



I own Crown Computers, a managed IT services company in San Diego, California - 30 years old, 13 people, around 76 business clients. I also own the domain 
, and I am starting an AI consulting business on it. Crown will be its sister company.



I am looking for one person to help me build it from close to zero.



WHAT THE BUSINESS SELLS



Small and mid-sized businesses everywhere are asking the same question: what can AI actually do for us? Most of them have nobody credible to ask. We answer that, and we get paid three ways: a paid AI readiness and risk assessment, ongoing AI governance and management, and building and maintaining the automations themselves.



And because Crown is a 30-year-old IT company, many of those conversations also turn into managed IT work. AI opens the door. IT often walks through it.



WHAT YOU WOULD ACTUALLY DO



You own getting us in front of San Diego businesses and getting meetings booked. How you do it is largely up to you - I care about booked appointments with real decision makers, not activity reports.



- Build an audience. Instagram, and whatever else you can prove works. Short video, real examples of AI doing something useful for an ordinary business, plain-English explanations that the 55-year-old owner of a plumbing company actually understands.

- Find the businesses worth talking to, and research them properly before we ever reach out.

- Run outreach that does not read like spam. We would rather send thirty genuinely personal messages than three thousand generic ones. That is a rule, not a preference.

- Book the appointments. At the start I take the meetings and you sit in and learn. As you get good, you run more of them.

- Keep the follow-up alive. Most deals are lost because nobody followed up in week three.

- Use AI to do all of this better than a human could alone - research, drafting, personalization, content. If you are not already doing that every day, this is the wrong role.



WHO THIS IS FOR



Someone entrepreneurial who wants to help build something, not be handed a script. If this works, you are running it, and your share grows with it. If you want stable and predictable, take one of our other jobs - we have four others posted right now and they are good jobs.



You should genuinely understand AI. Not as an engineer, but well enough to know what these tools really do and where they fall over, and to explain that to a business owner without jargon and without hype.



You need excellent spoken and written English. You are representing a San Diego company to American business owners.



Marketing, sales development, agency or BPO client-facing backgrounds all fit. GoHighLevel, HubSpot or similar is a plus. So is anything you have personally built an audience for.



THE HONEST PARTS



- This is a night shift. 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM in Manila. American businesses answer the phone during their day, not ours.

- This is early. The website is not finished. There is no big lead list waiting for you. You are helping build it - which is the whole point, and the reason it is interesting.

- We do not automate LinkedIn or scrape people. It violates their terms and gets accounts banned. We build a real audience and send real messages.

- We start with Crown's existing 76 clients, who already trust us, before going cold on strangers. Warm first is not a lack of ambition. It is just what works.

- You need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



PAY



Base of 1,500 to 2,500 USD per month depending on experience, PLUS a real share of the revenue of the business you are helping build. I will not put a percentage in a public job post, but I will tell you the number openly in our conversation and put it in writing. This is meant to be a founding-team arrangement, not a bonus scheme.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

AI Growth - [Your Name] - [a business you think AI could obviously help, and how]



2. Your resume, plus a link to anything you have built an audience for, even a small one. Show me the real numbers, honestly.



3. A voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this out loud and then answering it:

"Pretend I own a 20-person landscaping company in San Diego and I know nothing about AI. In two minutes, convince me to take a meeting with you."

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. For this role, the recording matters more than your resume.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation with me on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid exercise: pick ten real San Diego businesses, tell me why those ten, and write the outreach. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

title: Static Ad Designer for Ecommerce Brand
description:
We are looking for a creative and reliable Static Ad Designer to join our team part-time and create scroll-stopping graphic ads for our e-commerce brands.



We will provide the advertising brief, concept, product assets, copy, and reference examples. Your job will be to turn them into strong static ads that are ready to launch as
 ads.



You may design from scratch or use AI tools where appropriate, but the final work must look polished, intentional, and professional.



##Main Responsibilities:

- Create static image ads based on our briefs and reference examples

- Produce different design formats and visual styles within the same ad concept

- Create meaningful design variations, not simply change the headline or copy

- Follow the advertising angle and communicate the message clearly

- Maintain accurate product details and brand consistency

- Use strong visual hierarchy, typography, spacing, and composition

- Make revisions based on feedback

- Deliver final ads in the required sizes and formats

- Communicate clearly and submit work on time



For example, if one concept requires three variations, we expect three noticeably different visual approaches to that same concept. We do not want the same design repeated with only different headlines.



##Requirements:

- Experience creating static ads or e-commerce graphics

- Strong knowledge of Canva, Photoshop, Figma, or similar design tools

- Ability to understand and follow creative briefs

- A good eye for typography, layout, composition, and visual hierarchy

- Basic understanding of
 and Instagram advertising

- Ability to create multiple visual formats from one advertising concept

- Comfortable using AI tools when useful

- Open to feedback, revisions, and learning

- Reliable communication during working hours

- Able to meet deadlines without repeated follow-ups



##Position Details:

- Part-time

- Long-term opportunity

- Compensation: $300–$400 per month, depending on experience and quality

- Remote position



##Please fill this form to Apply: 

>Compulsory Trial Task and Loom Recording

>Shortlisted applicants will be given a trial design task.

>You will also need to submit a Loom screen recording showing your completed design and briefly explaining:



- How you understood the brief

- Why you chose that design format

- How you created the visual hierarchy

- What tools or AI platforms you used

- Why you believe the ad could work



You do not need to necessarily show your face. But we do need to see your screen, your design, and hear you explain your work.



Applications without the required portfolio or Loom submission will not be considered.



We are looking for someone who can take a brief and turn it into creative, visually different, launch-ready static ads rather than simply copying references or changing headlines.

title: 4mil+ subscribers - short form viral video editor
description:
Short-Form Video Editor Field Days YouTube (Full-Time)

Full-Time | Remote | Philippines |$700-$1200 per month  + 13th month pay depending on skills



About Us

We’re Field Days — one of Australia’s biggest outdoor/fishing YouTube brands, with 4M+ subscribers and followers across YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and
, a members-only streaming platform, and a merchandise store. We publish high-volume video content every week and we’re scaling our editing team.



This is a full-time seat on our creative team, working under our Marketing Manager with creative direction from our Design Lead. Your cuts will be seen by millions of people.



The Role

You’ll turn our long-form YouTube content and raw footage into scroll-stopping short-form video, and help cut long-form episodes as you grow with us:



Cut short-form reels daily for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts and
 — each one built around a hook in the first 2 seconds



Repurpose long-form YouTube episodes into multiple shorts per episode



Edit with retention in mind: pacing, cuts every few seconds, captions, sound design, pattern interrupts you know why people stop scrolling and you edit for it



Work with project management softwares



Take feedback fast: our leads review for craft, you revise same-day



Adapt edits per platform what works on TikTok is not what works on Instagram, and you know the difference

Assist on long-form YouTube edits as capacity allows



You Must Have

4+ years editing short-form content for real brands or creators (show us links)

Premiere Pro and/or DaVinci at professional speed

Proven understanding of hooks, retention editing and platform-native style

Strong captioning/typography and sound design fundamentals

Comfortable using AI tools to move faster (auto-captions, cutdowns, workflow tools)

Reliable internet, fast turnaround, and availability across Australian business hours (approx. 7:00am–4:00pm Philippine time)

Bonus: outdoor/fishing/adventure content experience, thumbnail design, After Effects motion graphics



HOW TO APPLY READ CAREFULLY, THIS IS THE INTERVIEW

We don’t shortlist from resumes. We shortlist from edits.



Your application task:

Go to our YouTube channel and pick any published Field Days video you like.



Cut TWO original short-form reels from it (30–60 seconds, 9:16 vertical, captioned):



Reel 1 — made for TikTok: raw, fast, native TikTok energy. Hook in the first 2 seconds or it’s a scroll-past.

Reel 2 — made for Instagram Reels: cleaner, more polished feel, still hook-first.



Upload both to Google Drive (make sure link sharing is ON “anyone with the link can view”).



Send your application starting with the word REELS, containing:

Your Google Drive link with both edits



2–3 sentences: which video you chose and why you built each hook the way you did



Links to short-form work you’ve done for other brands/creators



Your earliest start date



What we’re judging: the hook, the pacing, the captions, and whether each edit actually feels native to its platform. If we like your edits, we’ll contact you for an interview and a paid trial week.



Applications without the REELS keyword or the two edits will not be reviewed. Please don’t send generic showreels instead of the task the task IS the application.



Note: application edits may be used for our audience to see the reach of the reel or if the audience like it.

title: Sales Closer / Acquisition Manager / High Ticket Closer
description:
XYZ Consulting is a lead generation and sales automation agency. We

build done-for-you sales systems for business owners, and we need a

closer to turn our booked calls into signed clients.



This is not cold calling. Every call on your calendar is a warm,

pre-booked prospect who requested a free audit of their sales process.

Your only job is to run the call and close.



Base pay plus uncapped commission on every deal. Our retainers are

high-ticket, so strong closers earn well above base — your income

scales with performance, not hours.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Take 5-10 pre-booked calls per day (we generate every lead)

- Run our proven call framework and close on the call

- Handle objections, hold price, collect payment

- Log outcomes in our CRM and follow up with prospects who didn't close



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- A full calendar of warm, qualified appointments

- Tested script, objection framework, CRM, and dialer

- Direct training from the owner and recorded call reviews



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- Proven closing experience on high-ticket offers ($2,000+)

- Excellent spoken English — clear, confident, natural on the phone

- Holds frame on price without folding or discounting

- Reliable internet, quiet workspace, headset

- Available during US business hours



HOW TO APPLY

Reply with all of the following. Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with "I READ IT"

2. How do you handle "I need to think about it"? (2-3 sentences)

3. Your biggest closed deal and your close rate

4. A short voice recording or Loom so we can hear your phone presence



If it's a fit, we'll do a quick call where you'll run a mock close.



- Alex Murton, XYZ Consulting

title: Public Relations, Creator & Industry Partnerships Specialist
description:
Part-time | 20 hours per week | Long-term opportunity



We are looking for an experienced PR and creator partnerships specialist to help grow two Australian brands across the outdoor technology, hospitality, hunting and thermal imaging industries.



This is not a general social media or virtual assistant role. Your focus will be building credible third-party exposure through journalists, publications, online creators, reviewers, podcasts, industry partners and customer case studies.



Key responsibilities

* Research and identify relevant Australian journalists, publications, YouTubers, reviewers and online creators

* Develop tailored story angles and outreach pitches

* Build and manage ongoing media and creator relationships

* Coordinate product reviews, creator collaborations, interviews and content opportunities

* Manage follow-ups, product loans, timelines and campaign deliverables

* Help produce customer case studies, testimonials and proof assets

* Track opportunities, published coverage, referral traffic and commercial outcomes

* Work closely with company leadership and the marketing team, who will act as the public spokespeople



We are looking for someone who has

* Excellent written and spoken English

* Previous experience in PR, media outreach, influencer marketing or creator partnerships

* Strong research and relationship-building skills

* The ability to write personalised pitches rather than mass outreach

* Good commercial judgement and attention to detail

* Confidence communicating with Australian businesses, journalists and creators

* Experience with YouTube creators or technical/product-based industries is highly regarded



The role will begin at 20 hours per week across two companies. Our goal is to build this into a full-time long-term position if the channel proves successful and the workload supports it.

2. Examples of media coverage, creator campaigns or partnerships you have helped secure

Creating video ads that generate sales.



This is an ongoing opportunity based on performance. If your work delivers results, there will always be more work.



?



About the Role



I currently operate 3 eCommerce brands, producing approximately 45 new Meta ad videos every week.



Your role is to create high-converting video advertisements for
 and Instagram.



You won’t be starting from scratch.



I’ll give you access to:



* My complete B-roll library.

* Product videos.

* UGC content.

* Previous winning advertisements.

* Brand assets.

* Creative materials.

* Everything I’ve collected over time.



I’ll also personally train you and show you exactly how I create my ads, why they work, what has failed, and how I think when producing new creatives.



I’ve already built a system that works.



Each product follows proven creative concepts and multiple hooks.



Your job is to understand the system, improve it, and eventually create ads that perform even better than mine.



That’s the goal.



?



What I’m Looking For



I’m not looking for someone who simply edits videos.



I’m looking for someone who understands performance marketing.



Someone who thinks creatively.



Someone who enjoys testing new ideas.



Someone who wants to improve every single week.



I want someone who takes ownership of the creative process instead of waiting for instructions.



?



Skills Required



You should already know how to:



* Create high-converting Meta ads.

* Build strong hooks within the first 3 seconds.

* Create clean, professional subtitles.

* Use motion graphics and motion control naturally.

* Find additional B-roll or stock footage when needed.

* Keep viewers engaged with fast-paced editing.

* Match music and sound effects correctly.

* Create ads for both Norway and Denmark.



?



AI Experience



AI is becoming a huge part of content creation.



Experience with tools like ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, CapCut AI, Google Veo/Gemini, AI voice cloning, AI subtitles or similar tools is a big advantage.



If AI helps you work faster and create better ads, that’s exactly what I’m looking for.



?



Serious Applicants Only



I’m only interested in serious people.



If you apply, you must provide proof that you know what you’re doing.



Please include:



* Your best Meta/Facebook ad examples.

* Previous eCommerce work (if applicable).

* Portfolio.

* Results, case studies or creatives you’ve worked on.



Applications without previous work or proof of experience will not be considered.



?



Interview Process



Before we begin working together, we’ll have a short video meeting.



I want to get to know you, understand your experience, and make sure we’re a good fit for each other.



Communication and reliability are very important to me.



?



Payment



Starting pay is $3–4 USD per hour, depending on your experience.



If you consistently create great-performing ads, there will be more work, more responsibility and higher pay over time.



?



How to Apply



Please answer the following questions:



1. Tell me about yourself.

2. How long have you been editing videos?

3. Have you worked with eCommerce brands before?

4. Which editing software do you use?

5. Which AI tools do you use regularly?

6. Please send your best Meta/Facebook ads.

7. If I gave you one product video, how would you turn it into three completely different ads?

8. How many hours are you available each week?

9. What computer do you use?

10. What is your internet speed?

11. Why should I hire you instead of someone else?



Finally…



At the very top of your application, write the word “FLEXI” so I know you’ve read this entire job post.



I look forward to seeing your application.

title: E-commerce  growth manager
description:
Part-Time E-Commerce Growth Manager



Shopify, Meta Ads,
 Marketing & Conversion Optimization



Company: Winx+Blinx

Industry: Luxury Baby, Gift and Home Products

Work Arrangement: Remote

Schedule: Part-time, approximately 15–20 hours per week

Position Type: Long-term role, beginning with a paid 60–90 day trial period



About Winx+Blinx



Winx+Blinx is an established luxury baby and lifestyle brand specializing in premium blankets, hooded towels, loveys, personalized gifts, gift sets and home accessories.



We are now focused on significantly expanding our direct-to-consumer online business.



Our brand is known for luxurious textures, thoughtful personalization, beautiful gift-ready presentation and a clean, elegant visual identity. We are not looking for someone to simply maintain our website or post content. We are looking for a strategic, analytical and highly proactive E-Commerce Growth Manager who can turn website visitors into customers, increase repeat purchases and help us grow online revenue consistently.



The Role



The E-Commerce Growth Manager will take ownership of the strategy and execution required to grow sales through our Shopify website.



You will analyze our current performance, identify missed opportunities and implement improvements across website conversion, paid advertising,
 marketing, product merchandising, promotions, customer retention and reporting.



This is a hands-on role. You must be comfortable doing the work yourself—not only making recommendations or waiting for other tea
mbers to implement them.



You will work closely with the founder. The content creator will focus primarily on producing brand visuals, social media content and creative assets. You will be responsible for determining how those assets should be used to support sales, advertising campaigns, website improvements and customer acquisition.



Primary Goal



Your main goal is to increase profitable online sales for Winx+Blinx.



Success will be measured through improvements in areas such as:



- Website conversion rate

- Total online revenue

- Average order value

-
-generated revenue

- Returning-customer rate

- Add-to-cart and checkout completion rates

- Cost per acquisition

- Meta Ads performance

- Return on advertising spend

- Customer lifetime value



Key Responsibilities



1. E-Commerce Growth Strategy



- Review our Shopify website, analytics, customer journey and existing marketing efforts.

- Create a clear 30-, 60- and 90-day growth plan.

- Identify the most important opportunities to increase revenue and prioritize them according to potential impact.

- Develop monthly promotional and marketing plans around product launches, gift-giving occasions, holidays, personalization and seasonal buying behavior.

- Recommend practical strategies based on data, not generic marketing advice.

- Balance short-term revenue opportunities with long-term brand growth and customer retention.

- Present ideas clearly to the founder and explain why each recommendation should improve performance.



2. Shopify Website Conversion Optimization



- Review the full customer journey from the homepage through product discovery, cart and checkout.

- Identify website issues that may be preventing customers from purchasing.

- Improve homepage structure, collection pages, product pages, navigation, product recommendations and calls to action.

- Make sure customers immediately understand the quality, value, benefits and uniqueness of our products.

- Improve product descriptions, merchandising and presentation to support stronger conversion.

- Test strategies such as bundles, upsells, cross-sells, complementary products and gift-set recommendations.

- Improve the presentation of personalization options and gift-ready features.

- Review mobile usability and ensure the mobile shopping experience is easy and attractive.

- Recommend and implement appropriate Shopify apps only when they provide a clear benefit.

- Avoid unnecessarily adding apps that slow down the website or create additional expenses.

- Monitor website speed and customer experience.

- Plan and evaluate A/B tests or structured conversion tests when appropriate.

- Help increase average order value without damaging the premium brand experience.



3. Meta Ads Management



- Develop and manage Meta advertising campaigns across
 and Instagram.

- Review any existing campaigns, tracking and account structure.

- Confirm that the Meta Pixel, Conversion API and relevant events are installed and functioning correctly.

- Build campaigns for customer acquisition, retargeting, product launches, best sellers, gift sets and seasonal promotions.

- Create clear campaign structures with appropriate audiences, budgets and objectives.

- Develop creative briefs for the content creator based on advertising needs.

- Test multiple creative concepts, messages, hooks, audiences and offers.

- Monitor advertising performance consistently and make informed adjustments.

- Pause weak campaigns and scale stronger campaigns responsibly.

- Track cost per purchase, return on ad spend, click-through rate, conversion rate and other meaningful performance indicators.

- Clearly explain what is working, what is not working and why.

- Work effectively with an initially modest advertising budget.

- Understand that strong performance must be demonstrated before recommending major increases in advertising spend.

- Avoid relying only on boosted posts or vanity metrics such as likes and followers.



Experience managing e-commerce Meta Ads with limited or growing budgets is highly preferred.



4.
 and Customer Retention Marketing



- Review or help set up our
 marketing platform and customer segmentation.

- Create or improve essential automated
 flows, including:

  - Welcome series

  - Abandoned-cart flow

  - Abandoned-checkout flow

  - Browse-abandonment flow

  - Post-purchase follow-up

  - Product-review request

  - Cross-sell and complementary-product flow

  - Repeat-purchase or customer win-back flow

  - Personalized-product education

  - Back-in-stock notifications

- Create a realistic
 campaign calendar.

- Develop campaigns for launches, new collections, best sellers, gift sets, holidays and promotions.

- Segment customers based on purchase history, engagement, product interest and customer behavior.

- Improve
 subject lines, offers, messaging and calls to action.

- Monitor revenue generated from
, open rates, click rates, conversion and unsubscribe rates.

- Maintain a premium brand voice and avoid excessive discounting or sending too many promotional
s.



5. Product Merchandising and Promotional Strategy



- Identify products with the strongest potential for acquisition, gifting, bundling and repeat purchases.

- Recommend which products should be featured on the homepage and in paid campaigns.

- Create strategies for best sellers, new arrivals, seasonal items, personalized products and gift sets.

- Help develop bundles that make purchasing easier and increase order value.

- Recommend strategic offers without weakening the luxury positioning of the brand.

- Review product pricing, perceived value and promotional opportunities.

- Help plan inventory-focused promotions when appropriate.

- Use sales and customer data to identify which products should receive more attention.

- Make sure promotions are easy for customers to understand and profitable for the company.



6. Analytics, Tracking and Reporting



- Review Shopify analytics, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics and other available reporting tools.

- Verify that tracking is accurate before making major conclusions.

- Establish baseline performance metrics at the beginning of the role.

- Create a simple weekly dashboard or report that the founder can easily understand.

- Track the most meaningful performance indicators rather than overwhelming the team with unnecessary data.

- Use data to identify customer behavior, sales patterns and areas of lost revenue.

- Clearly connect completed work to measurable business results.



Your weekly report should include:



- Work completed during the week

- Current website sales and conversion performance

- Meta advertising spend and results

-
 campaign and automation performance

- Changes in average order value

- Important observations or concerns

- Tests currently running

- Results from completed tests

- Priorities for the following week

- Any assets or decisions needed from the founder



7. Collaboration and Communication



- Communicate directly and clearly with the founder.

- Work collaboratively with our content creator.

- Provide the content creator with specific briefs for advertising and sales-focused assets.

- Request the exact materials needed instead of giving vague directions.

- Maintain organized task lists, deadlines and project updates.

- Raise problems early rather than waiting until a deadline is missed.

- Be comfortable receiving feedback and adjusting quickly.

- Respect the established Winx+Blinx brand identity.

- Maintain consistent communication during agreed working hours.

- Attend a weekly strategy and performance meeting.



First 30 Days



During the first month, we expect the selected candidate to:



- Complete a full audit of the Shopify website and online sales funnel.

- Review current analytics, conversion rate, traffic sources and sales performance.

- Review Meta advertising accounts and tracking.

- Review current
 marketing setup and automations.

- Identify the biggest obstacles affecting online sales.

- Establish baseline performance metrics.

- Create a prioritized 30-, 60- and 90-day growth plan.

- Implement the highest-impact website improvements.

- Improve or launch essential abandoned-cart and welcome
 flows.

- Develop the first structured Meta Ads testing plan.

- Create a promotional and campaign calendar.

- Establish a clear weekly reporting system.



We do not expect every issue to be solved immediately. However, we expect the candidate to quickly identify priorities, take action and demonstrate organized progress.



Required Qualifications



Applicants should have:



- Proven experience growing sales for a Shopify-based e-commerce brand.

- Strong understanding of Shopify, online merchandising and conversion optimization.

- Hands-on experience managing Meta Ads for physical consumer products.

- Experience building and optimizing
 campaigns and automated flows.

- Strong understanding of customer acquisition and customer retention.

- Ability to analyze data and turn it into practical action.

- Experience improving conversion rate, average order value and customer lifetime value.

- Excellent written English and clear verbal communication.

- Strong organizational and project-management skills.

- Ability to work independently and manage priorities without constant supervision.

- A proactive, problem-solving mindset.

- Experience collaborating with designers, content creators or founders.

- Respect for luxury branding and visual consistency.

- The ability to explain marketing performance in language that a business owner can easily understand.



Preferred Experience



The following experience would be especially valuable:



- Experience with baby, children’s, gifting, home, lifestyle, fashion or luxury consumer brands.

- Experience marketing personalized products.

- Experience with gift-focused e-commerce businesses.

- Experience working with a founder-led small or midsize brand.

- Experience growing a business with a modest initial advertising budget.

- Experience with Klaviyo or a comparable e-commerce
 platform.

- Experience with Google Analytics 4.

- Experience with Shopify reporting and customer segmentation.

- Experience creating product bundles, upsells and cross-sells.

- Experience planning holiday and seasonal sales campaigns.

- Basic ability to make Shopify theme updates or coordinate simple technical changes.

- Understanding of SEO fundamentals.

- Familiarity with Google Shopping or other paid acquisition channels is a plus, but Meta Ads will be the initial priority.



Who Will Be Successful in This Role?



This role is best for someone who:



- Thinks like an owner and takes responsibility for results.

- Enjoys finding opportunities that others overlook.

- Is both strategic and hands-on.

- Can work with limited resources and prioritize intelligently.

- Understands that revenue growth requires more than posting on social media.

- Is comfortable testing ideas and learning from the results.

- Does not make unrealistic guarantees.

- Communicates honestly when something is not working.

- Focuses on profitable sales rather than vanity metrics.

- Can protect a premium brand while still driving strong action and conversion.

- Understands the emotional nature of baby gifting and can translate that into effective marketing.

- Can move forward independently after receiving clear goals and brand direction.



This Position Is Not a Fit for Someone Who:



- Only provides strategies but does not implement them.

- Mainly specializes in organic social media management.

- Measures success primarily through likes, views or followers.

- Has no direct experience with Shopify e-commerce.

- Has never managed paid advertising for physical products.

- Uses the same generic strategy for every business.

- Requires constant direction for routine tasks.

- Cannot explain advertising performance clearly.

- Recommends increasing advertising budgets without first improving tracking, creative and conversion.

- Makes guaranteed promises about revenue or return on ad spend.

- Does not pay close attention to brand presentation.

- Is managing too many clients to give this role consistent attention.



Working Hours and Availability



This is initially a part-time role requiring approximately 15–20 hours per week.



The schedule can be flexible, but the selected candidate must:



- Maintain consistent weekly availability.

- Complete agreed assignments by their deadlines.

- Respond to important messages within a reasonable timeframe.

- Be available for one scheduled weekly meeting.

- Be able to communicate during at least some overlapping U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

- Provide advance notice regarding planned time off or changes in availability.



The position may grow in hours and responsibility based on performance, business needs and measurable sales growth.



Compensation



Compensation will be based on experience, skills and demonstrated results.



Please include your requested:



- Hourly rate

- Monthly part-time rate for 15–20 hours per week

- Preferred payment structure

- Weekly availability

- Earliest possible start date



Please do not apply with commission-only proposals. A performance bonus may be considered after a strong baseline of performance, accurate tracking and clearly defined targets have been established.



Trial Period



The selected candidate will begin with a paid 60–90 day trial period.



The purpose of the trial is to evaluate:



- Quality and speed of implementation

- Strategic thinking

- Communication

- Organization

- Reliability

- Ability to understand our customers and brand

- Improvement in website performance

- Quality of advertising decisions

- Ability to use data effectively

- Overall contribution to online revenue growth



Continuing the position long-term will depend on performance, collaboration and the quality of the candidate’s work.



How to Apply



To be considered, please begin your application with the words:



“I am ready to grow Winx+Blinx.”



Applications that do not include this sentence may not be reviewed.



Additionally, please include the word “blanket” somewhere naturally in your application to confirm that you have carefully read this entire posting.



Please provide the following:



1. A brief introduction explaining why you are a strong fit for Winx+Blinx.



2. A description of your direct Shopify e-commerce experience.



3. Two or three examples of e-commerce brands you have worked with.



4. Your exact responsibilities for each brand. Please clarify what you personally implemented versus what was completed by other tea
mbers.



5. Examples of measurable results you helped achieve, including any available:

   

   - Revenue growth

   - Conversion-rate improvement

   - Average-order-value improvement

   -
-generated revenue

   - Cost-per-acquisition improvement

   - Return on advertising spend

   - Repeat-customer improvement



6. One example of a Meta Ads campaign you personally managed. Please include:

   

   - Product or industry

   - Campaign objective

   - Monthly or total budget

   - Audience strategy

   - Creative strategy

   - Cost per purchase

   - Return on ad spend

   - What you changed to improve performance



7. Your experience with
 marketing and automated flows.



8. Your experience with Shopify website conversion optimization.



9. The tools and platforms you use regularly.



10. Your hourly or monthly rate for 15–20 hours per week.



11. Your weekly availability and preferred working schedule.



12. Your current number of active clients or other ongoing jobs.



13. A link to your portfolio, case studies or examples of your work.



14. Contact information for one or two professional references, if available.



Application Assignment



After reviewing our website, please answer the following questions in your application:



Question 1



What are the five most important changes you would recommend to increase online sales for Winx+Blinx?



Please be specific. Avoid general answers such as “improve SEO,” “post more content” or “run more ads.”



Question 2



What would you improve first on our homepage, product pages or overall customer journey, and why?



Question 3



How would you use an initial Meta Ads budget of approximately $500 per month?



Please explain:



- Campaign structure

- Budget allocation

- Audiences

- Retargeting

- Creative testing

- Performance expectations

- How you would d
 whether to scale, pause or change a campaign



Question 4



Which
 automations would you prioritize during your first month, and why?



Question 5



Choose one Winx+Blinx product or collection and explain how you would market it to increase sales.



Question 6



What would your first 30 days in this position look like?



Question 7



Please record a short 5–10 minute Loom video reviewing our website. In the video, explain:



- The strongest parts of the current website

- The biggest conversion problems you notice

- What you would change first

- One growth opportunity you believe we may be overlooking

- How your experience would help you execute these changes



We are looking for thoughtful, specific observations. We are not looking for a complete free strategy or extensive unpaid work.



Important Note



Please do not submit AI-generated or generic answers without reviewing our brand and website carefully. We value the appropriate use of AI tools, but your application must demonstrate your own judgment, experience and understanding of our business.



Generic applications sent to multiple companies will not be considered.



We are looking for a long-term growth partner who is genuinely excited about helping Winx+Blinx become a stronger direct-to-consumer brand.

title: Operations Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing creator management agency scaling rapidly in both revenue and roster size. The single biggest lever on our revenue is operational consistency — making sure every creator on our platform is supported by systems, standards, and workflows that convert and monetise their audience reliably and at scale. This role owns that engine.



WHAT WE OFFER

— Competitive compensation based on experience

— Fully remote, full-time (9am-6pm PHT, Mon-Fri)

— Reports directly to the Chief Revenue Officer

— A systems-ownership role with real impact on revenue at scale

— A fast-moving, operationally serious team that builds to last

— Clear path to grow as the roster and operations function scale



THE ROLE

This role does not sell. It makes selling repeatable.



As Operations Manager you will own the operational engine behind our creator portfolio. You will build, document, and continuously improve the workflows, quality standards, and content systems that allow the Chat team to convert and monetise every audience — consistently and at scale. You will manage the Content VA and Audience Engagement VA, with scope to grow the team as the operation scales.



Success here is defined by how reliably the system performs — not by how much work you personally do.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- The operations system end to end — maintain core workflows covering content planning, PPV and customs preparation, welcome bundles, profile optimisation, audience engagement, and cross-team issue resolution, fully documented so execution never depends on any single person

- The weekly operating cadence — lead a data-driven weekly review of every creator's core quality metrics, translate gaps into specific production actions, and hold the team accountable against a visible scorecard

- Quality and content standards — QA every workflow output against a defined quality standard before it reaches the Chat team, with a strong audience-experience lens so content is packaged to convert

- Documentation and systemisation with AI leverage — convert tacit know-how into clear, adopted SOPs, using AI tooling to build and maintain workflows quickly and keep them current

- Team leadership and cross-functional collaboration — coach and develop the operations team, partner with Chat and Client Success to resolve creator concerns within SLA, protecting retention and reducing churn

- Portfolio prioritisation — review account performance weekly, identify lagging accounts, prioritise operational resources based on revenue opportunity and risk, and track improvement plans through completion



NON-NEGOTIABLES

— Documentation discipline: if it isn't in the system, it doesn't exist

— Data over opinion: every decision on content, profiles, and priorities is anchored to performance data, reviewed weekly

— Standards leadership: holds the line on quality and process even under pressure to cut corners for short-term output



WHAT YOU WILL BE MEASURED ON

— Weekly deliverables consistently shipped on time and meeting defined QA standards

— Operational issues resolved within agreed SLAs, each with a durable fix logged

— Quality trends improving consistently across the portfolio, with lagging accounts closed rather than ignored

— Chat team consistently receiving complete, production-ready content and assets

— Documentation enabling rapid onboarding and reducing dependence on any single individual Targets and weightings set quarterly with the Chief Revenue Officer.



WHAT YOU BRING

Experience (non-negotiable)

— 3+ years in operations or operations leadership within a remote, fast-paced business — agency, SaaS, startup, eCommerce, BPO, customer operations, or creator business

— Demonstrated ownership of documented workflows and SOPs with measurable process improvement

— Experience managing a remote team or direct reports

— Creator economy or subscription platform experience preferred but not required



Skills (must-have)

— Workflow platforms — Process Street, ClickUp, Asana, or similar

— AI tools — Claude, ChatGPT, or equivalent — used to build and maintain processes

— Strong spreadsheet and data literacy, comfortable turning numbers into action

— Comfortable analysing operational dashboards, identifying bottlenecks, and translating data into clear operational actions

— SOP writing, documentation, and project management

— Clear written and verbal English

— Sound visual and creative judgment — able to raise the quality of profiles, welcome bundles, and content with a strong audience-experience lens, while keeping execution consistent and on-standard



Who you are (non-negotiable)

— Highly accountable, structured, and detail-oriented

— Calm under pressure, coachable, and curious

— A natural systems-improver who leads through influence and accountability

— Comfortable with change and building in a fast-moving environment



LOGISTICS

Location: Remote. Philippines preferred, South Africa considered.

Hours: Full-time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week. Overlap window with Revenue team hours to be confirmed.

Language: Clear written and verbal English required

Reports to: Chief Revenue Officer



ASSESSMENT

Shortlisted candidates will complete a timed operations diagnostic evaluating analysis, workflow redesign, documentation, prioritisation, and operational judgment. No industry-specific knowledge required.

Pay: $5–$7 USD/hr depending on experience Schedule: Part-time or Full-time available | US business hours M-F | Setup: Remote / Work from home | Long-term for the right person

Ask qualifying profile questions (age, household size, income range, zip code, etc.)

Log call outcomes and lead details accurately in CRM (GoHighLevel experience is a plus)

Hit daily call volume and lead targets

Minimum 1 year of experience on US-facing outbound call campaigns

Clear, confident English with a neutral or minimal accent

Comfortable making 80–150+ outbound calls per day

title: Content & Social Media Manager
description:
About the role



We're looking for a Content & Social Media Manager to own our content strategy across our website and social channels, creating material that genuinely resonates with dental practice owners and staff.



This is a content-first role: strong, valuable writing matters more to us than posting frequency. You'll need to understand what dental practice managers and principals actually care about, day to day, and translate IT and security topics into content that's useful to them, not generic marketing filler.



What you'll be doing

- Create weekly blog content for the 32byte website, written specifically for a dental practice audience, then help turn that content into supporting social media posts and
 newsletters

- Produce a monthly case study showcasing real client outcomes, and adapt it into a series of social media posts

- Manage our social media presence across Instagram,
, and LinkedIn, adapting content to suit each platform

- Help create more authentic, behind-the-scenes content — photos and short videos of the team — to bring some personality to our brand

- Support ongoing content and social media posting for a separate musician's website, as an additional content stream alongside your core work



What we're looking for

- Comfortable writing and editing content for a specific professional audience (healthcare, dental, or B2B services experience highly regarded)

- Confident managing a content calendar and juggling a few concurrent projects

- Experience running business social accounts (IG, FB, LinkedIn) — scheduling tools, platform-specific formatting, and engagement basics

- Comfortable with basic photo/video content

- Bonus: interest or experience in music/artist content, given the additional website you'll support



Exact workflows, tools, and cadence will be discussed further at interview.



About 32 Byte



Here at 32 Byte we pride ourselves above all on our ability to create lasting relationships. While we are an IT MSP, we are not your typical IT company. We love building authentic, genuine partnerships with our clients and employees, and like to think of our network as an extension of our family.



If you're tired of seeing jobs asking for all the technical skills and not looking at the person you are, then maybe this one is for you. While we would love you to have bundles of experience, years of training and a cupboard full of degrees, we'd actually prefer you have the right attitude.



What we offer



We work hard, but we reward those who do. If you can come in each day with a positive, outgoing attitude, get through your work, and help the rest of the team, you'll fit right in.



Added bonus points if you're into Mexican food, vendor events, and can make a great double espresso.



A personal touch and attention to detail matter more to us than anything else in this role.

title: Account Manager (MSP) - QBRs, Client Success, AI-Aware - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and we are hiring an Account Manager in the Philippines to own our client relationships and run our Quarterly Business Reviews.



Right now the owner does this job. That is the problem. He cannot scale, and our clients deserve someone whose whole job is thinking about them.



WHAT A QBR IS, AND WHY IT MATTERS HERE



Every quarter we sit down with a client and show them they are not on autopilot - that we are measuring their environment, we know where it is weak, and we have a plan. We use ScalePad Lifecycle Manager to do it.



Our internal playbook defines success in one sentence, and this is the standard you would be held to:



"Move at least one initiative from Proposed to Approved by the end of the meeting. If you leave with everything still Proposed, you did not run a QBR, you ran a status update."



A DAY IN THE LIFE



- Preparing QBRs. Our engineers score the technical assessment - you never do, because they know the environment. You take that scored assessment and turn it into the client story: create the Initiatives from the at-risk items, write the budgets, build the roadmap, write the client Goals.

- Running the future-dated comparison assessment. This is the heart of it: today they score 38 percent, and if they approve these four initiatives they score 69 percent by September. That side-by-side is what makes a client say yes. It is yours to own.

- Building the deliverable and picking the right template for the audience. A CEO gets goals, roadmap and budget. An IT director gets technical detail. An office manager wants assets and renewal dates.

- Running the meeting. Presenting live, sending the PDF after, creating the follow-up action items.

- Chasing the initiatives between quarters. This is where most MSPs fail. Approved work that nobody follows up on is worth nothing.

- Getting involved when a client has a problem. Not fixing it yourself - making sure the right person owns it and the client knows where things stand.

- Talking with clients about AI. Every business owner is asking what AI can do for them. You need to hold that conversation credibly - Microsoft 365 Copilot, where AI actually saves a small business time, what governance and acceptable use mean - without pretending to be an engineer.



WHAT WE NEED



- You have worked in or around managed IT services and understand what an MSP does. This is not a role you can learn from scratch.

- You can talk to an American business owner as a peer. Calm, warm, organized, and you follow up when you say you will.

- You are comfortable with numbers - budgets, roadmaps, renewal dates - and you write clean executive-level English.

- You are curious about AI and already use it in your own work.

- ConnectWise, ScalePad Lifecycle Manager, Kaseya or Hudu experience is a real advantage. If you have not used them, you must be quick with new software.



THE HONEST PART



This is client-facing work with American clients, live, on camera. Your spoken English has to be genuinely excellent, not just good written English. We screen for that early because it is the whole job.



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift and it is not flexible, because client meetings happen in US business hours.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work. You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your opinion on how to do something better



PAY



2,500 to 4,000 USD per month, based on experience and English. We pay at the top of that range for someone who can genuinely run the room.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

Account Manager - [Your Name] - [the last book that changed how you work]



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a client relationship you saved, or one you lost. What did you do, and what would you do differently?"

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed. For this role especially, we need to hear you speak.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation with the owner on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid exercise: we give you a real client scenario and you build the business review. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

title: Technical Project Manager (MSP) - ConnectWise, IT Projects - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and we are hiring a Technical Project Manager in the Philippines.



Here is the honest reason this job exists. Over the last 18 months we delivered 63 client projects, and they were managed by five different people who all have other full-time jobs - including the owner. Five projects were cancelled, two went at risk, and nine are sitting in planning waiting for someone to drive them. Nobody owns project management here. That is the seat.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



The projects are real and they repeat. In the last 18 months:



- Microsoft 365 and
 migrations - the single most common project we run

- Workstation and laptop rollouts - ten machines at a time, imaged, configured, delivered

- Server replacements and virtualization

- New client onboarding - taking over an environment from another IT company

- Firewall, WiFi and network upgrades

- Intune and Entra ID rollouts, backup projects, phone system cutovers



Your job is to make those land on time, on budget, and without the client wondering what is happening:



- Take a scoped project and turn it into a real plan: tasks, sequence, hours, who does what, and when.

- Schedule our engineers and keep them unblocked. Chase the dependency nobody noticed - the switch that has not shipped, the license nobody bought, the client contact who has not replied.

- Be the client's single point of contact for the project. They should always know what is next and never have to ask.

- Run it all in ConnectWise Manage on the project board, with time logged against the project so we know whether we made money.

- Catch scope creep early and raise a change order instead of eating the hours.

- Close the project properly: documentation into Hudu, handoff to the service team, and a client who is genuinely happy.



WHAT THIS ROLE DOES NOT INCLUDE



You will not manage our CMMC and defense-compliance projects. Those involve controlled government data with strict rules about who may access it, and they stay with our US-based team. We are telling you up front so there is no confusion later.



WHAT WE NEED



- Real project management experience inside an MSP or IT services company. This is the hard requirement. We do not care about PMP, CAPM or Scrum certificates - they are a nice bonus, not a substitute for having actually run IT projects.

- Enough technical literacy to hold a schedule together and know when an estimate is wrong. You do not have to be the engineer. You do have to know what a domain migration involves and roughly how long it should take.

- The organized, slightly stubborn personality that follows up until something is actually done.

- Clear written and spoken English - you will be
ing and talking with American clients.

- ConnectWise Manage experience is a real advantage. Kaseya, Hudu or Microsoft 365 familiarity helps.



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift, and it is not flexible, because you need to be reachable while our engineers and clients are working.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work. You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your opinion on how to do something better



PAY



2,000 to 3,200 USD per month, based on experience and English.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

Project Manager - [Your Name] - [how many projects you are running right now]



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a project that went sideways. What went wrong, what did you do about it, and what did you tell the client?"

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we do this so we do not waste your time or ours on a call that was never going to work.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid exercise: we hand you a real project scope and you build the plan. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

Good eye for clean, clickable thumbnail design

Strong English comprehension

Reliable communication and quick response time

Detail-oriented and able to follow instructions closely

Open to feedback and committed to improving over time

Able to work independently without constant supervision

Quiet, distraction-free home workspace

title: Appointment Setter | Full Time | Remote Nested Housing | Short Term Rental Co-Hosting
description:
This Role Is Not For Everyone. It Is For One Person.



That person wakes up with something to prove. They do not need to be managed. They are not looking for a comfortable job. They are looking for a launchpad, a team that will invest in them the same way they invest in themselves, and a role where their effort directly shapes the trajectory of a growing company.



If that is you, keep reading.



What We Do:

Nested Housing is a co-hosting and short term rental company built on one non-negotiable: every person who interacts with us leaves better than when they arrived. Whether they become a client or not. That is the standard we hold ourselves to every single day.



We are not a big corporate team. We are a tight group of people who care deeply about each other, about the people we serve, and about the long term vision we are building together. We invest in our people the way we invest in our business, because the people are the business.



The Role and Why It Matters:

Right now, qualified prospects are coming in and not getting the attention they deserve. Cold leads are sitting untouched. Follow ups are being missed. Appointments are not being booked fast enough for our closing team.



You are the person who fixes that.



As our Appointment Setter, you are the first voice and the first relationship a prospect has with Nested Housing. When you perform at the highest level, our closers close, our business scales, and our mission reaches more people. This role is the engine of our entire revenue operation. It is not small, and we will not treat it that way.



What winning looks like in this role:

Qualified appointments are consistently booked for our closing team. Leads are nurtured with genuine care, not a script. Every prospect interaction reflects the standard of Nested Housing, value first, always. Outcomes are tracked, patterns are identified, and you bring insights back to the team without being asked.



The Daily Reality:

This is a full time role. It is your only job. We are not your side hustle and you are not ours.



Your day runs from 8AM to 5PM EST. Within that window you will be doing high volume outbound outreach across multiple channels, vetting and qualifying leads, booking appointments, updating our Google Sheets and Notion pipeline, attending team calls and accountability sessions, and submitting your end of day and end of week reports without exception.



There is no version of this role where you coast. There is a version where you grow faster than you thought possible.



Who This Is Actually For:

You do not need years of experience in appointment setting. You do need the following, and there is no substitute for any of it:



You have a long term vision for yourself and you are actively working toward it. You hold yourself accountable before anyone else has to. When something goes wrong, you look inward first. You are deeply coachable, not because you are passive, but because you understand that learning faster is how you win. You thrive in a team environment and genuinely want to see the people around you succeed. You are the kind of person who reads the entire job description.



To confirm you did, include the phrase "I build, I grow" somewhere in your application.



You are growth-oriented, proactive, and you bring energy to the work even on the days it is hard. You are honest, even when the truth is uncomfortable. You would never sell someone on something you do not genuinely believe will help them.



This Is Not For You If:

You are looking for something flexible to fit around other commitments. You externalize blame when results are not there. You need to be pushed to do the basics. Your words and your actions do not match.



Where This Goes:

We promote from within.



The path is real: Setter, Lead Setter, Closer, Acquisitions Manager.



What we are building is not a temporary business. The culture, the relationships, and the experiences you gain here will have a long term impact on who you become, not just what you earn.



Compensation is performance-based and tiered. The better you perform, the more you earn. Full details are discussed during the interview process.



Ready to Apply?

Submit your application here: tally.so/r/NpExWQ



Incomplete applications will not be considered. Low effort responses will not be reviewed. If your application is vague, surface level, or shorter than the care this opportunity deserves, it will not move forward.

description:
About XANS



XANS is a growing online clothing brand looking for a reliable, detail-oriented Customer Support Virtual Assistant to manage our Instagram DMs and Gmail customer-support inbox.



This is a long-term position for someone who writes clearly, communicates professionally, understands streetwear customers, and can handle customer service, sizing questions, promotional inquiries, and collaboration requests.



Main Responsibilities



• Respond to customer inquiries through Instagram DMs and Gmail

• Answer questions about products, sizing, fit, shipping, tracking, orders, discount codes, and product availability

• Recommend clothing sizes based on the customer’s height, weight, and preferred fit

• Check Shopify and carrier tracking before providing order updates

• Respond to promotional, modeling, influencer, and collaboration inquiries

• Collect relevant information from creators, including their social media username, follower count, average views, location, clothing size, and requested collaboration

• Use our approved templates while making each response sound natural and personal

• Direct customers to the XANS website and mention that we ship worldwide when relevant

• Assist with incomplete addresses, delayed shipments, delivery problems, and tracking concerns

• Organize conversations that require follow-up

• Escalate complicated or sensitive situations to the owner

• Send an end-of-shift report covering unresolved cases, refund requests, delivery issues, and promising collaboration opportunities



Important Rules



• Never approve a refund, return, cancellation, exchange, replacement, or free product without permission

• Never promise a creator a free item, paid promotion, modeling position, or collaboration without approval

• Never provide an unauthorized discount code

• Never promise an exact delivery date unless it has been confirmed

• Always verify order and tracking information before responding

• Never argue with, insult, threaten, or disrespect a customer

• Never admit that XANS made a mistake without first verifying the situation

• Keep all customer and creator conversations professional and business-related

• Do not move customers or creators to a personal account

• Escalate legal threats, chargebacks, fraud concerns, harassment, and serious complaints immediately

• Keep all customer and business information private and confidential



Requirements



• Strong written English, grammar, and reading comprehension

• Previous customer-support or e-commerce experience

• Experience using Instagram, Gmail, Shopify, and order-tracking websites is preferred

• Experience handling influencer, promotional, or collaboration inquiries is a plus

• Basic understanding of clothing sizing and oversized streetwear fits

• Able to communicate in a friendly, casual, and professional tone

• Detail-oriented and able to follow written policies and templates

• Able to remain calm when handling upset customers

• Reliable computer and stable internet connection

• Able to work independently while knowing when approval is required

• Available to work consistent hours that overlap with U.S. Central Time



Compensation



• $3–$4 USD per hour, depending on experience

• Opportunity for a raise based on accuracy, reliability, communication, and long-term performance



How to Apply



Please submit a proper and updated professional resume in PDF format. Your resume should clearly include your previous employment, customer-support experience, relevant skills, software experience, education, and contact information.



Your application must also include:



1. A brief introduction about yourself

2. Your previous customer-support or e-commerce experience

3. The platforms you have used, including Instagram, Gmail, Shopify, or similar tools

4. Your available working hours in U.S. Central Time

5. Your expected hourly rate

6. A link to your OnlineJobs.ph profile

7. The words “XANS SUPPORT” at the beginning of your application so we know you read the entire post



Please answer all three situations below:



Situation 1:



A customer says:



“My tracking has not updated in seven days, and I want a refund right now.”



Write the exact response you would send to the customer.



Situation 2:



A creator says:



“I love your brand. Can you send me free clothes so I can promote you?”



Write the exact response you would send to the creator.



Situation 3:



A customer asks:



“What size should I wear if I’m 5’7” and 160 lbs?”



Write the exact response you would send. Make sure you explain the difference between the recommended regular fit and a more oversized fit.



Applications without a proper resume or answers to all three situations will not be considered. Please do not use AI-generated answers.

title: L3 Network Engineer + AI Automation Specialist (MSP) - Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, and this is the most unusual role we have ever posted.



We need one person who is genuinely two things: a Level 3 network engineer, and someone who builds AI automation. Most people are one or the other. If you are both, keep reading, because we will pay for that.



WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS



Our clients are asking what AI can do for their business, and we are past the point of guessing. We are building an AI practice: we sit down with a client, find the work that is eating their people's hours, and build something that takes it over. Then we manage and govern it every month.



You would be the technical half of that. And because you are also an engineer, you understand the systems the automation has to plug into - which is exactly why hiring two separate people does not work.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



- Sitting in a discovery call with me and a client, asking hard questions about how their business actually runs. Where do people burn hours? What gets copied between systems by hand? You are listening for the thing worth automating.

- Turning that into a real scope: what we build, what it costs one time, and what it costs monthly.

- Then building it. Support bots that answer the repetitive 50 to 60 percent of customer questions. Lead enrichment so a salesperson walks into a call already knowing who they are talking to. Automations that read
, pull data across systems, and take a whole process off a human's plate.

- Wiring AI into things that already exist: Microsoft 365 and Copilot, APIs, databases, ticketing systems.

- Governance: watching what the agents are actually doing, proving nothing strange is happening, and keeping records a client can show an auditor. AI governance is becoming a real standard (ISO 42001) and we intend to be good at it.

- And the engineering half: escalated tickets, Entra ID and Active Directory, firewalls, servers, migrations. You are still an engineer here.



WHAT YOU NEED ON THE AI SIDE



Real, shipped work - not a course certificate. LLM APIs, agents and tool use, RAG, automation platforms, and scripting in Python or PowerShell. If you have built something that is running in production and saving somebody hours every week, that is exactly what we want to hear about.



WHAT YOU NEED ON THE ENGINEERING SIDE



ConnectWise, Kaseya, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V and VMware, Sophos / SonicWall / Ubiquiti firewalls, VPNs, DNS, switching, backups, and Hudu for documentation. You will not know all of it. Know most of it and learn the rest fast.



THE PART MOST ENGINEERS FIND HARDEST



You will be in the room with business owners. You need to explain a technical idea to a non-technical person and make them feel smart, not stupid. You need to hear "we just do it that way" and gently dig until you find out why. Your spoken English has to be very good, because you will be talking, not typing.



If sitting in a client meeting sounds worse than the technical work, this is the wrong role - and the other two jobs we have posted may fit you better.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other. Whoever we add has to fit that:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your technical opinion on how to fix something



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday. In Manila that is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM. It is a night shift. Client discovery calls happen during US hours and you need to be in them, so this one is not flexible.



We have a 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work - we do not sit on a video call all day.



You also need genuinely reliable internet and a computer, plus a backup plan for when the power goes out.



PAY



3,500 to 5,500 USD per month. This is well above our normal engineering range because the combination is rare. If you are genuinely strong at both halves, say so and we will talk.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

AI Engineer - [Your Name] - [the last thing you automated]



2. Your resume, plus a link to or a short description of something you actually built with AI.



3. A voice recording of yourself - WAV or MP3, two to three minutes - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a time you watched someone doing a repetitive task and worked out how to automate it. How did you explain it to them?"

No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we need to hear how you explain things, because that is half of this job.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a conversation with me on Microsoft Teams.

Stage 3 - a paid hands-on exercise on a real automation problem. We pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )
