title: Customer Support Representative — US E-Commerce Brand (Shopify + Email)
description:
About Us



We're a US-based direct-to-consumer brand selling a premium home cleaning tool. We were doing $300k/month before pausing briefly for inventory, and we're now scaling back up with a target of $1M/month during Q4.



Our customers are mostly men and women aged 50+ in the US. They are warm, chatty, and appreciate a real human response. Tone matters enormously in this role — a fast reply that sounds robotic is worse than a slightly slower one that sounds like a person who cares.



The Role



You'll own our customer support inbox: Shopify Inbox (live chat),
, and occasional 
ments.



Realistically this is about 2 hours of actual work per day once the backlog is cleared. We're paying for 4 hours/day because we want you available, responsive, and not rushing. Same pay whether it's a quiet day or a busy one (busy days will be no more than 4 hours of work. If it is, we will pay overtime).



First priority: we have roughly one week of unanswered tickets that need to be cleared fast.



What You'll Do

- Answer product questions (surface compatibility, attachments, battery, warranty)

- Handle "where is my order?" inquiries — look up orders, pull tracking, communicate status

- Process refunds and replacements in Shopify

- Correct shipping addresses on unfulfilled orders

- Troubleshoot basic product issues using our SOP (charging, attachments, assembly)

- Flag anything unusual to me rather than guessing

- Keep our response templates updated as new situations come up



You'll be given a detailed SOP document covering product specs, response templates, formatting rules per channel, and escalation protocols. You won't be improvising. However, you will encounter new situations that the SOP don't cover. For those situations, you can let us know and we'll tell you how to handle it. You will be in charge of managing the SOP and templates for your own sake.



You will also be required to communicate with our supplier agent to handle specific issues with an order. For example if a defective product is sent to a customer, you would ask the customer for proof and send to the supplier agent via whatsapp to request a free replacement.



Requirements



Must have:



- Excellent written English — near-native. This is non-negotiable. Our customers are older Americans and they notice.

- Prior hands-on Shopify admin experience (orders, refunds, draft orders, fulfillment)

- Experience with a helpdesk tool (Gorgias, Zendesk, Re:amaze, Freshdesk, or Shopify Inbox)

- Previous customer support role for a US or Western DTC e-commerce brand

- Reliable internet and a backup power/internet plan



Strongly preferred:



- You've independently processed refunds and replacements before, not just escalated them

- You can describe an SOP you actually followed at a previous brand

- Experience handling shipping delays and frustrated customers without escalating the emotion

- Comfortable with repetitive volume without getting sloppy



Not required:

- Phone support. This is 100% written. You will never have to get on a call with anyone.



Compensation & Growth

- Starting: $160 USD/week for 20 hrs/week

- Paid weekly

- As we scale into Q4, hours and pay both increase — you'll get plenty of notice before any change

- Growth path: If performance is strong, we intend to promote our best rep into a Customer Service Manager role to oversee additional support reps and own the function end to end. This is a real path, not a dangled carrot — we'll need that role filled by Q4.



How to Apply



Please send:



A short intro — who you are and which brands you've supported

Which Shopify functions you've personally used (be specific: refunds? draft orders? fulfillment?)

Which helpdesk tools you've worked in

Your available hours in US Eastern Time



The more information you provide for us, the better!!!



Please start your application with the word "SPARKLE" so I know you read the full post. Applications without it will not be reviewed.



Looking forward to reading your responses!

title: Customer Success Manager
description:

Loop Voice builds best-in-class AI voice agents for Shopify brands: agents that recover abandoned



checkouts, win back lapsed customers, confirm orders, and answer the phone at 2 a.m. — and sound so



good doing it that shoppers say “thank you” before they hang up.







We’re hiring a Customer Success Manager to help us make the best brands in ecommerce even better. Not



a ticket-closer. Not a check-in-call scheduler. An owner.







First — why Loop Voice? We asked the team. Here’s what they said.



• “You’re working on the frontier.” AI agents that hold real, natural phone conversations barely



existed two years ago. Here, you don’t read about the future of commerce — you listen to it, live,



every day.



• “The speed is addictive.” A customer insight on Monday is a script change by Wednesday and a



better conversion number by Friday. No committees. No quarterly roadmap theater.



• “You own your work and your hours.” We don’t believe in clocking in and clocking out. This is not a



nine-to-five — it’s a mission you can push as fast and as hard as you’re capable of. The people who



thrive here wouldn’t have it any other way.



• “Your growth compounds.” You’ll build rare, in-demand expertise at the intersection of



conversational AI and ecommerce — years before most people get anywhere near it.



• “Zero corporate nonsense.” Small team, sincere candor, no politics. The best idea wins, even when it



stings.







The role



You’ll own our client relationships end to end — from the first onboarding call through renewal and



expansion — and you’ll be the reason merchants tell their friends about us.







We want a CSM so driven to make customers successful that they take personal pride in every account.





The kind of person who listens to calls the 
nt an agent goes live. Who hears the half-second pause



where a shopper lost interest — and rewrites the script that afternoon. Who tunes the flow, tightens the



follow-up SMS, then refreshes the dashboard to watch the conversion number move. Who knows, in their



bones, what a great phone conversation sounds like: the pacing, the warmth, the exact 
nt to ask for



the sale.







What you’ll actually do:



• Own a portfolio of fast-growing Shopify brands from day one through renewal, expansion, and beyond



• Listen relentlessly: review call recordings the 
nt agents go live, catch where they underperform, and fix it fast



• Optimize scripts, conversation flows, and follow-ups hand in hand with our team — then prove the lift with data



• Spot patterns across accounts: if a certain type of call keeps going sideways, you see it first and you kill it



• Be the voice of the customer inside Loop Voice, turning what you hear into product improvements that actually ship



• Help write our customer success playbook itself — you’re early, and the way we do CS will carry your fingerprints







What winning looks like



No vague stuff. You’ll know you’re succeeding when:



• Your brands go live in days, not weeks — and see results inside their first month



• Agent performance climbs month over month on your accounts — more calls connected, more checkouts recovered, fewer drop-offs — because you kept turning the screws



• Renewals feel like formalities, because the value has been obvious all year



• Expansion comes fro
rchants asking for more — not from you pushing



• The product roadmap visibly carries the evidence you brought in



• Merchants name-drop you when they refer other brands to us







Who we’re looking for



• Proven SaaS customer success experience with SME to mid-market accounts — you’ve owned a book of business, carried renewal and expansion goals, and hit them



• Hands-on experience working with Shopify stores — you speak fluent merchant: AOV, LTV, abandoned checkout, repeat rate



• A sharp, trained ear for conversation — you can tell exactly why a call worked or didn’t, and put it into words



• Comfort deep in call data — transcripts, connection rates, conversion funnels — and confidence drawing conclusions from it



• High energy and competitive greatness — you play to win, and you hate losing an account more than almost anything



• Sincere candor — you say the true thing, kindly and fast, to customers and teammates alike



• A self-starter who doesn’t need heavy oversight — you see what needs doing, and you do it







Bonus points for:



• Background in voice, call-center QA, or conversational AI



• Experience with CRM or customer success platforms



• A track record of influencing product roadmap with customer evidence







Where and how we work



We’re remote today. Early next year we’re opening our office in the Los Angeles area and building an in-person team there — we believe the best companies are built shoulder to shoulder. You should be in LA, or excited to get there.







And how we work: fast. Bold ideas, and the freedom to execute them — that’s our formula. We don’t measure hours; we measure outcomes. If you want a place to hide, this isn’t it. If you want a place to run, welcome home.







The sound of what’s next



This position will be filled immediately for the right candidate — we move at the same speed we expect from you.







If you read this and felt your pulse pick up: apply now, and tell us about a customer you made wildly successful — and exactly how you did it.

mbers, preparing accurate financial statements, analyzing accounting data, and helping business owners understand what their financial information means.



This is not a basic bookkeeping or transaction-categorization position. We need someone who can independently handle the accounting records of multi-million-dollar companies, identify serious bookkeeping and financial-reporting problems, correct the records, analyze business performance, and provide meaningful financial recommendations.



The ideal candidate must be highly proficient in U.S. GAAP, QuickBooks, Xero, Microsoft Excel, accounting-data analysis, budgeting, forecasting, cash-flow analysis, and management reporting.



Primary Responsibilities



Accounting Cleanup and Review



Review existing bookkeeping for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with U.S. GAAP.

Perform complex QuickBooks Online, QuickBooks Desktop, Xero, and accounting-system cleanups.

Review bookkeeping completed by other accountants and bookkeepers.

Analyze the general ledger, trial balance, balance sheet, profit and loss statement, and supporting schedules.

Identify incorrect classifications, duplicate transactions, missing transactions, unsupported balances, and reconciliation problems.

Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, loans, merchant processors, payroll accounts, clearing accounts, and intercompany balances.

Correct accounts receivable and accounts payable discrepancies.

Review and correct undeposited funds, suspense accounts, opening balance equity, retained earnings, owner equity, and uncategorized transactions.

Review payroll expenses, payroll liabilities, sales-tax liabilities, loan balances, fixed assets, accumulated depreciation, prepaid expenses, deferred revenue, accruals, and other balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare and post adjusting journal entries.

Manage month-end and year-end closing procedures.

Maintain supporting schedules, reconciliation workpapers, cleanup logs, and complete audit trails.



Excel and Accounting Data Analysis



Use advanced Microsoft Excel to organize, clean, analyze, and reconcile large accounting datasets.

Combine data from QuickBooks, Xero, banks, payroll systems, merchant processors, and other platforms.

Analyze general-ledger and transaction-level data to identify errors, duplicates, unusual activity, missing information, and financial trends.

Use PivotTables, Power Query, XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, SUMIFS, IF formulas, dynamic arrays, data validation, conditional formatting, and other advanced Excel functions.

Build repeatable Excel models and templates for accounting reconciliations and financial analysis.

Perform data cleanup, account mapping, transaction matching, variance analysis, and trend analysis.

Create dashboards, charts, schedules, and management reports that clearly explain financial performance.

Validate the completeness and accuracy of imported or exported accounting data.

Work efficiently with large data files containing thousands of transactions.



Budgeting and Forecasting



Prepare annual operating budgets based on historical results and management assumptions.

Create monthly, quarterly, and annual financial forecasts.

Develop rolling 12-month forecasts.

Prepare revenue, expense, payroll, capital-expenditure, and working-capital projections.

Compare actual results against budgets and forecasts.

Investigate and explain significant budget-to-actual variances.

Update forecasts based on current financial performance and changing business conditions.

Build scenario models showing best-case, expected-case, and worst-case results.

Help management understand the financial impact of hiring, pricing, expansion, financing, and other business decisions.



Cash-Flow Analysis



Prepare direct and indirect cash-flow analyses.

Develop weekly and monthly cash-flow forecasts.

Create rolling 13-week cash-flow models.

Analyze expected customer collections, vendor payments, payroll obligations, loan payments, taxes, and other cash requirements.

Identify potential cash shortages before they occur.

Analyze working-capital trends, including accounts receivable, accounts payable, inventory, and operating cash requirements.

Recommend ways to improve cash flow, collections, payment timing, and working-capital management.

Monitor actual cash activity against forecasted cash flow and explain major differences.



Financial Reporting and Business Recommendations



Prepare accurate balance sheets, income statements, cash-flow statements, and management reports.

Develop monthly financial-reporting packages for business owners and management.

Analyze revenue growth, gross profit, operating expenses, margins, customer concentration, and profitability.

Identify unusual financial trends, declining margins, increasing costs, or potential operational problems.

Calculate and analyze financial and operational key performance indicators.

Review profitability by customer, product, location, department, class, or service line.

Translate bookkeeping information into clear business insights.

Make practical recommendations based on financial results.

Identify areas where the company may be overspending, underpricing, losing money, or using cash inefficiently.

Recommend improvements to accounting procedures, internal controls, reporting, and financial management.

Clearly explain financial information to business owners who may not have an accounting background.



Required Qualifications



Master’s degree in Accounting

CPA License

At least 10 years of professional accounting, financial-analysis, or full-cycle bookkeeping experience.

At least five years of experience working directly with U.S.-based businesses or U.S. accounting firms.

Significant hands-on experience with complex bookkeeping cleanup and catch-up projects.

Experience reviewing the bookkeeping work of other accountants or bookkeepers.

Advanced knowledge of U.S. GAAP, accrual accounting, adjusting journal entries, and financial-statement preparation.

Advanced QuickBooks Online experience.

Strong QuickBooks Desktop and Xero experience.

Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.

Experience analyzing large accounting datasets.

Experience creating budgets, forecasts, cash-flow projections, and financial models.

Ability to analyze business performance and provide meaningful financial recommendations.

Strong understanding of balance-sheet reconciliations and supporting schedules.

Ability to independently investigate accounting discrepancies.

Excellent written and spoken English.

Strong professional judgment, critical-thinking ability, and attention to detail.

Ability to communicate complex accounting and financial information clearly.

Ability to manage multiple clients and meet deadlines without sacrificing accuracy.

Reliable computer, high-speed internet, backup internet connection, and backup power solution.

Willingness to follow strict confidentiality, cybersecurity, and data-protection procedures.

Be able to work US Eastern Standard Time schedule





What Success Looks Like



A successful candidate will be able to:



Take over disorganized books and determine what is wrong without requiring step-by-step instructions.

Develop and execute a complete accounting-cleanup plan.

Produce reconciled and properly supported balance-sheet accounts.

Prepare a reliable trial balance and accurate financial statements.

Review another bookkeeper’s work and identify errors that others may overlook.

Analyze large accounting datasets efficiently using Excel.

Build a usable budget, forecast, and cash-flow model from historical bookkeeping data.

Explain why actual results differ from the budget or forecast.

Identify meaningful trends and risks from the company’s financial information.

Provide practical recommendations that help business owners improve profitability, cash flow, and financial controls.

Communicate findings clearly through workpapers, reports,
s, and meetings.





Compensation and Benefits

PHP 100,000–140,000 per month, based on experience and demonstrated ability.

Salary paid twice per month.

13th-month-equivalent bonus after completing the applicable service period.

Paid time off after the probationary period.

Performance-based salary reviews and bonuses.

Long-term and stable employment.

Opportunity to grow into an accounting-manager, financial-analysis, or fractional CFO support role.

Direct exposure to complex U.S. companies and advanced accounting and advisory projects.





How to Apply



Begin your application subject line with:



SENIOR ACCOUNTING ANALYST – [Your Full Name]



Submit the following:



Your resume.

A link to your LinkedIn profile, if available.

Copies or links to your accounting, QuickBooks, Xero, Excel, or financial-analysis certifications.

A short video of no more than four minutes explaining:

The most complicated accounting cleanup you have completed

Complete answers to all application questions.



Applications that do not follow these instructions or provide complete answers will not be considered.

Rate your ability from 1 to 10 in each area and briefly explain each rating:

QuickBooks Online

title: Outbound Cold Caller – Australian B2B (Neutral/American Accent Required)
description:
We're an Australian AI automation agency. You'll be cold calling Australian business owners to book discovery meetings for us. Straight outbound dialling — no inbound, no chat support, no admin.



**READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING**



This role calls Australian business owners who hang up fast. You need to sound neutral or American on the phone. If your accent is noticeably Filipino, please don't apply.  We will reject you and it wastes both our time. Be honest with yourself here.



**What you'll do**

- 100+ outbound dials per day using our dialler 

- Work Manila 7am-3pm (Melbourne 9am-5pm). Non-negotiable, these are the only hours that work.

- Book qualified meetings into our calendar

- Log every call outcome in our CRM



**What you need**

- 2+ years outbound calling on a US, UK, or Australian account at a real business 

- Outbound sales or appointment setting specifically. nNot inbound customer service

- Wired internet connection (not WiFi) and a proper USB headset

- Backup power/internet arrangement

- You can handle rejection all day without going flat by 11am



**HOW TO APPLY - follow this exactly or you'll be rejected**



Do not send a CV or a generic intro video. Send a single audio recording, roughly 90 seconds, with these three parts:



1. **(30 sec)** Read this script word for word:

*"Hi, is that [name]? My name's ___, I was just reaching out because we build AI automation systems for Australian businesses to replace admin tasks. Have you looked at anything like that before?"*



2. **(30 sec)** In your own words, unscripted: why would a business owner want to take this call?



3. **(30 sec)** Unscripted: respond to a prospect saying *"I'm not interested, we already have someone doing that."*



Also tell us in your message:

- Which businesses you've worked (company + region)

- Your internet setup (wired or WiFi, speed, backup plan)



Applications without the audio recording will not be read. Applications that only include part 1 will not be read.



**What happens next**

Shortlisted candidates do a live call with us, then a paid trial on real dials before any ongoing arrangement.

title: Marketing Manager
description:
We're a Sydney-based brand identity and design execution studio, built on a simple belief: brands should feel like something, not just look like something.



We work with clients to build identities, logos, and design systems that come from real strategy and real story — never templates, never shortcuts, and never AI-generated logos. Every piece of work we put out is grounded in a "why," designed with intention, and crafted with genuine care for the details.



We're not a hustle studio. Our team is fully remote, and we believe calm creativity and high standards aren't in tension — they're exactly how great work gets made. We plan, we communicate, and we create with intention. That's the whole philosophy.



We're looking for a Marketing Strategist to work closely with our Creative Director on a daily basis, building out and running the marketing engine for Complete Street itself. This is a genuinely diverse role — social media strategy,
 marketing, content planning, and data — all pointed at one goal: growing the agency, increasing our lead flow, and making sure everything we put out is consistent, strategic, and unmistakably us.



You won't be handed a rigid playbook. We want someone who can bring fresh thinking, spot what's working in the market, and shape a marketing approach that actually fits who we are — not a copy-paste of what every other agency is doing.



YOU'LL BE DOING THIS IF:



You have real experience in the marketing industry — this isn't an entry-level role

You're a creative thinker and creative problem solver — you can look at a goal and find more than one way to get there

You bring fresh ideas and stay on top of trends, without chasing every trend just because it's trending

You're comfortable with data — you can look at performance and know what it's telling you, not just report the numbers

You have experience with Flodesk and Squarespace (highly regarded, not necessarily essential)

You can build and maintain consistency — content calendars,
 cadence, social presence that doesn't go quiet for weeks then spike

You think strategically about lead generation, not just visibility for its own sake

You communicate clearly and proactively — this role works closely with our Creative Director daily, so alignment matters

Ideally have experience with paid advertising i.e. Meta, Google etc 



WHAT WE OFFER



A collaborative, growth-focused team — not a solo freelance gig dressed up as a job

A genuinely calm, welcoming studio culture — high standards paired with real support, not pressure

Clear career progression — discussed openly every quarter so growth is never a guessing game

Adobe Creative Cloud + Canva Pro provided

Weekly pay based on hours worked

Paid birthday day off

Quarterly professional development bonus

Employee of the Month bonus

Quarterly 1:1s focused on your growth, workload, and goals — not just performance

Monthly team workshops for ideas, trends, and feedback in a supportive environment



WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE HERE



Communication — proactive, clear, responsive. You flag problems before they become problems.

Reliability — you do what you say, when you said you'd do it.

Strategic thinking — you connect marketing activity back to real business growth, not just output for output's sake.

Independence — you know when to make the call and when to check in.

Ego-free collaboration — you build marketing that reflects the studio's values and voice, not just your own preferences.



HOW TO APPLY



Tell us about a marketing initiative you led that actually moved the needle — what the goal was, what you did, and what the data told you afterward. We want to see how you think, not just what channels you've used.

title: Sales Business Manager
description:
We are a fast-growing events and entertainment company specialising in the hire of premium event experiences, including photo booths, video booths, 360 booths, backdrops, and interactive event equipment.



Alongside our events division, we also sell these products as complete "business in a box" opportunities, helping entrepreneurs start and grow their own businesses. Our product range includes photo booth businesses, AR and VR experiences, vending machines, and other exciting revenue-generating opportunities.



As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an experienced Sales Manager who can take ownership of the sales process, build relationships, and consistently drive results.



The Role



This is a fast-paced position suited to someone who thrives in sales and enjoys managing multiple opportunities at once. You'll be responsible for generating new business, following up on enquiries, nurturing leads, and closing sales across both sides of our business.



Your responsibilities will include:



Cold calling prospective customers and businesses.

Following up with existing leads via phone,
 and messaging.

Managing inbound enquiries efficiently throughout the day.

Selling both our event hire services and our business opportunity packages.

Building long-term relationships with prospects.

Keeping detailed records of customer interactions within our CRM.

Working towards monthly sales targets and KPIs.

Identifying new sales opportunities and helping grow the business.

Providing excellent customer service from first enquiry through to sale.

About You



We're looking for someone who is confident, organised and commercially driven.



You'll ideally have:



Proven experience in a sales management or senior sales role.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

The ability to absorb and retain product knowledge quickly.

Confidence making high volumes of outbound sales calls.

Strong follow-up skills—you understand that persistence closes deals.

Excellent organisation and time management.

A professional, articulate and personable manner.

Experience working with CRM systems.

A target-driven mindset with a genuine desire to succeed.



Experience within events, hospitality, franchising or business opportunity sales would be advantageous but is not essential.



Performance Expectations



This is a results-focused role.



You'll work towards agreed monthly sales targets and KPIs and will be supported with a structured onboarding programme. A performance improvement plan (PIP) will be used where required to ensure expectations and objectives remain clear.

title: Job Application Support — $6/hr, 20 hrs/month
description:
Hello,



Here's my offer. The work is straightforward: applying to jobs with my CV, writing cover letters, and keeping a simple tracker of what's been submitted.



The terms:



Rate: $6/hour

Time: No more than 4 hours per week — 20 hours per month total

Proof of work: A simple log of every application submitted (job title, company, link, date) so I can track performance

For context on the rate: I hire remote workers in the Philippines at $5–9/hour for complex tasks, so $8 for application work is the top of that range. If it's outside your scope, no hard feelings — I'll look elsewhere.



The upside: if the first month goes well, this grows. I have business-level work on my website waiting — at a higher hourly rate. Prove the simple work first, and we'll talk.



If this works for you, we have a deal. Let me know and I'll send over my CV, target roles, and LinkedIn access details.



Thanks,

Patrick

*

title: Product Engineer
description:
About ARKI

ARKI is an AI-powered productivity platform for architecture and engineering (AE) firms. We turn fragmented project data into a centralized, reusable system of record. We automate routine work, organize data from tools like Revit, and pair it with strong search and AI. Trusted by 100+ AE professionals. 

Learn more at 
.



The Role



We are hiring a Product Engineer for a remote role. We welcome applicants who can maintain meaningful overlap with our core collaboration hours across the Pacific (PST/PDT) and Eastern (EST/EDT) time zones.

We are an AI-first company. AI is woven through how we work, and especially how we ship products thus, expectations for speed, clarity, and follow-through are high. We run a daily release cadence, keep short feedback loops with customers, and stay close to how the product behaves in production once it is live. You will do well here if you are energized by shipping often, learning quickly, and making customer issues short-lived.

ARKI is interdisciplinary by design. The work sits at the intersection of PropTech and software engineering: you will partner with people who think in buildings, projects, and delivery, not only in code. Curiosity about the domain is part of the job; many problems only click once you understand how architectural firms work, and that context is a real input to how we design and ship.

You will own features end to end: partnering with customers, shaping flows, and shipping software. Some days that is React and TypeScript product work. Other days it is Python and Django APIs and data. On the desktop side it is Revit integration, threading, stability, and packaging so the web product and BIM stay in sync.



What you will do

- Ship full-stack product: Build and maintain features across React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Python, Django Ninja, and PostgreSQL

- Ship the Revit bridge: Extend and harden our C# / .NET add-in for Revit with WPF

- Scale and integrate AI: Improve performance, concurrency, and cloud workflows (Google Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks). Wire LLM and vector retrieval where the product needs intelligence.

- Stay close to users: Partner with AE firms to turn workflow pain into product on the web and inside Revit.



What we are looking for:

You do not need to be senior in every area below. We expect deep strength in one of these lanes (typically full-stack web or desktop and Revit / .NET), plus a track record of learning adjacent stacks quickly and shipping with them. The rest should be meaningful experiences you can grow from, not mastery on day one.

- 5+ years of experience building production ready software. 

- Autonomy and Adaptability: A self-starter who can work through ambiguity both as an individual and collaboratively, demonstrating a balance of independence and teamwork.

- Product-minded builder: You care about UX and outcomes, not only implementation.

- Full-stack web: Solid React and TypeScript and Python backend experience (Django or a close equivalent), PostgreSQL, and thoughtful API design.

- Desktop and plugin strength (strongly valued): Comfort shipping Windows desktop software

- Systems thinking: Debugging cross-process issues, API reliability, and performance under real customer load.

- Communication: Clear collaboration with engineers and non-technical clients.

- Education: Bachelor's in CS, engineering, or equivalent experience.

Bonus

- Experience with vector search, LLM or VLM (vision / visual language model) integrations, model fine-tuning or domain adaptation, or high-concurrency cloud backends.

- Revit API or other CAD and BIM extensibility

- CI/CD for desktop: e.g. NUKE, GitHub Actions, Inno Setup



Why Join ARKI?

- A Playground for Growth: You don't need to be an expert in everything on day one. We hire for a "spike" in either web or desktop/Revit, which means we actively want to pay you to learn the other side on the job. You will emerge as a highly versatile, cross-domain engineer.

- Bleeding-Edge Tech: No legacy code! You will be getting your hands dirty with applied AI, from vector search and LLMs to Vision Language Models (VLMs) solving novel problems that haven't been solved in this industry yet.

- Zero Bureaucracy, High Autonomy: You won't be a cog in a massive machine. You will own entire features end-to-end, speak directly with the people using your product, and see your code go live in a matter of days.

- AI-Supercharged Workflow: Because we are AI-first, we practice what we preach internally. You'll be equipped with the best AI coding tools available, allowing you to bypass boilerplate and focus entirely on the hard, interesting engineering problems.

- Remote & Flexible: We trust our team. Enjoy the flexibility of a remote-first culture that values your output and impact over hours logged at a desk.

title: Brand Designer

BRAND DESIGNER — COMPLETE STREET (REMOTE, FULL-TIME)



Sydney-based brand identity studio | Fully remote team, PH-based



ABOUT US



Complete Street is a Sydney-based brand identity and design execution studio. We build brands that have a real point of view — logos, identities, and design systems that come from strategy and story, not templates.



We're not a hustle studio. We believe in calm creativity, clear communication, and high standards — and we don't think those things are in tension. Our philosophy is simple: we plan, we communicate, and we create with intention.



If you've ever finished a logo and felt nothing — because it was fast, safe, or spat out by a prompt — this probably isn't the place for that kind of work. We want designers who can look at a brief, understand what a business is actually trying to say, and build something with story, emotion, and craft behind every decision. No AI-generated logos. Ever. We care about the thinking that gets you there as much as the output itself.



THE ROLE



We're looking for a Brand Designer to join our fully remote team and take real ownership of branding projects — from initial concept through to final delivery.



This isn't an execution-only role. We want someone who brings ideas into the brief, not just interprets it literally. You'll be trusted to think strategically, defend your creative decisions with rationale, and push projects further than the brief on its own asks for.



YOU'LL BE DOING THIS IF:



You've worked in an agency environment and understand what it means to deliver client-ready work under real deadlines

You have experience in strategic design — brand identity that's built on a "why," not just a "what looks nice"

Your communication is exceptional. This is the single most important trait we screen for. If you go quiet when something's unclear or running late, this role isn't for you. If you flag things early, ask good questions, and keep people in the loop without being chased — you'll thrive here.



WHAT WE OFFER



A collaborative, growth-focused team — not a solo freelance gig dressed up as a job

Quarterly professional development bonus

 Employee of the Month bonus

Communication — proactive, clear, responsive. You flag problems before they become problems.

Reliability — you do what you say, when you said you'd do it.

Brief comprehension — you read the full brief, ask the right questions upfront, and never guess.

Independence — you know when to make the call and when to check in.

HOW TO APPLY

2 - Tell us about a project where the brief could have been solved a dozen safe ways — and explain the direction you chose, and why. We want to see your thinking, not just your portfolio.

title: Video Editor for Restaurant Social Media
description:
We are looking for a talented and creative short-form video editor to edit high-quality food videos for our restaurant’s TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts accounts.



We will provide you with raw vertical 9:16 footage of our food and restaurant. 



****Your job will be to transform the raw footage into attention-grabbing, fast-paced videos that stop viewers from scrolling, keep them engaged, and make the food look irresistible.****



We are not looking for someone who only knows how to cut clips together. We need an editor who understands short-form content, viewer psychology, retention, storytelling, and what makes food videos perform well on social media.



## Responsibilities



* Edit raw 9:16 restaurant footage into engaging short-form videos

* Create a powerful hook within the first 1–3 seconds

* Select the strongest and most visually appealing clips

* Use clean transitions, sound effects, motion graphics, zooms, speed ramps, and other effects when appropriate

* Add captions, text overlays, headlines, and calls to action

* Match cuts and transitions to music, sound effects, and trending audio

* Use pattern interrupts to maintain viewer attention

* Make food look as appetizing, crispy, juicy, cheesy, and satisfying as possible

* Edit videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts





## You Must Understand



* How to create a strong first-three-second hook

* How to increase viewer retention and watch time

* How to build curiosity and create satisfying payoffs

* How to identify and remove slow or unnecessary footage

* How to structure short-form food content for social media

* When to use fast cuts, slow motion, close-ups, text, and sound effects

* Current TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts editing styles

* The difference between professional editing and unnecessary effects that distract from the food



## Requirements



* Proven experience editing short-form social media content

* Strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels, or YouTube Shorts edits

* Food, restaurant, hospitality, or product-video experience is strongly preferred

* Experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, Adobe After Effects, CapCut, etc....

* Strong sense of pacing, timing, music, storytelling, and visual composition

* Ability to follow a brand style while also bringing creative ideas

* Excellent attention to detail

* Reliable communication

* Ability to complete edits with a quick turnaround time

* Stable internet connection and the ability to download and upload large video files

The ideal editor actively studies successful restaurant and food creators and understands why certain videos go viral.

title: Senior Paid Media Buyer & Analytics Manager - Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager
description:
Senior Paid Media Buyer & Analytics Manager - Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager



Position Summary



We are seeking a highly analytical, strategic, and hands-on  Senior Paid Media Buyer & Analytics Manager to lead our digital acquisition efforts across Google Ads, Meta Ads, paid lead vendors, and marketing analytics.



This role owns the full lifecycle of paid media—from strategy and campaign execution to attribution, conversion tracking, reporting, optimization, and budget management. The successful candidate will be responsible for maximizing lead generation performance while ensuring the integrity of marketing data across multiple platforms.



Working closely with Executive Leadership, Marketing, Business Intelligence, Intake, Technology, and Web Development teams, this individual will drive data-informed decisions that improve marketing efficiency, lead quality, and return on advertising investment. This is a high-impact role requiring both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with the opportunity to grow into broader marketing leadership responsibilities as the organization continues to expand.



---



Key Responsibilities



Paid Media Strategy & Management



* Own and manage paid acquisition across Google Ads and Meta Ads.

* Develop and execute paid media strategies aligned with business growth objectives.

* Manage campaign budgets, bidding strategies, pacing, forecasting, and monthly spend optimization.

* Optimize campaigns at the account, campaign, ad group, audience, and keyword levels.

* Conduct keyword research, search term analysis, negative keyword management, and match-type optimization.

* Write, test, and optimize ad copy and collaborate on creative development.

* Review and optimize landing pages to improve conversion performance.

* Execute A/B testing and implement continuous optimization strategies.

* Allocate budgets across channels based on performance and business priorities.



Marketing Analytics & Performance Reporting



*Develop and maintain performance reporting across all paid acquisition channels.

* Analyze and report on Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Signup (CPS), Cost Per Client Acquisition (CP-COCA), lead quality, campaign performance, keyword performance, budget pacing, forecasting, and marketing ROI.

* Build executive-level reporting and dashboards that provide actionable business insights.

* Deliver ongoing recommendations that improve acquisition efficiency and overall marketing performance.



Attribution & Marketing Measurement



* Own the organization's marketing attribution framework and conversion tracking strategy.

* Manage Google Ads conversion tracking, Meta Pixel, Google Analytics 4, UTM governance, conversion actions, and event validation.

* Audit tracking implementations to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

* Reconcile performance data across Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, Five9, CallRail, and Business Intelligence (SQL Warehouse).

* Identify reporting discrepancies, determine root causes, and implement long-term solutions to improve measurement accuracy.



Campaign Development & Growth Initiatives



* Lead new digital acquisition initiatives from concept through launch and ongoing optimization.

* Conduct market and competitive research to identify growth opportunities.

* Develop campaign strategies, audience targeting, creative direction, landing page requirements, tracking implementation, and launch plans.

* Monitor campaign performance and continuously optimize for lead quality and return on investment.



Marketing Technology & Website Optimization



* Partner with Web Development and Technology teams to ensure marketing systems accurately measure customer acquisition.

* Oversee website conversion tracking, form integrations, pixel implementation, landing page optimization, UTM governance, and technical quality assurance.

* Troubleshoot tracking and attribution issues to maintain reliable marketing data.



Vendor Performance Management



* Evaluate the performance of third-party lead generation vendors.

* Analyze lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and return on investment.

* Provide recommendations on vendor performance and investment decisions.



SEO & Organic Performance Support



* Collaborate with SEO partners to improve organic acquisition performance.

* Audit SEO reporting, validate performance metrics, identify keyword opportunities, and support technical SEO initiatives using industry tools and competitive analysis.



Cross-Functional Collaboration



* Partner with Executive Leadership, Marketing, Business Intelligence, Technology, Web Development, Creative, Intake, and external vendors.

* Serve as the organization's subject matter expert for paid media, marketing analytics, attribution, and digital acquisition strategy.

* Provide strategic recommendations that support business growth and improve marketing effectiveness.



---



Qualifications



Required



* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

* Minimum 7 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads, Meta Ads, and performance marketing campaigns.

* Demonstrated experience managing six-figure monthly Google Ads budgets, with direct responsibility for campaign strategy, bidding, optimization, forecasting, and performance.

* Proven success delivering measurable business outcomes through paid media and digital acquisition.

* Advanced expertise with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics 4, conversion tracking, attribution, and marketing analytics.

* Strong understanding of campaign optimization, budget management, forecasting, and performance measurement.

* Experience interpreting and reconciling data across multiple marketing, CRM, and reporting platforms.

* Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel.



Preferred



* Experience working with SQL-based reporting or Business Intelligence platforms.

* Experience with CallRail, Five9, SEMrush, and other marketing technology platforms.

* Google Ads and Google Analytics certifications.

* Experience in legal services or another highly competitive lead generation industry is strongly preferred.



---



Core Competencies



* Paid Media Strategy

* Google Ads & Meta Ads

* Marketing Analytics

* Attribution & Conversion Tracking

* Budget Management

* Campaign Optimization

* Marketing Technology

* Data Analysis & Reporting

* Executive Communication

* Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Strategic Planning

* Continuous Improvement



---



To Be Considered



Please include the following information with your application:



* The industries or verticals where you have achieved the strongest paid media results (e.g., Legal, Professional Services, Healthcare, Financial Services, Home Services, SaaS, E-commerce, etc.).

* The approximate monthly Google Ads and Meta Ads budgets you have personally managed.

* Specific performance metrics you achieved, including Cost Per Lead (CPL), Cost Per Acquisition (CPA), conversion rates, lead volume, return on ad spend (ROAS), or other measurable business outcomes.

* A brief overview of the optimization strategies, attribution improvements, or campaign initiatives that contributed to those results.

* Your level of experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics 4, conversion tracking, attribution, and marketing analytics.



Preference will be given to candidates with demonstrated success managing six-figure monthly Google Ads budgets in a lead generation environment. Experience in legal services is highly preferred.



---



Why Join Us



This is an opportunity to own and shape a sophisticated paid media and analytics function with significant visibility across the organization. You will work directly with Executive Leadership, influence marketing investment decisions, and play a critical role in driving business growth through data-driven acquisition strategies. As the company continues to grow, this role offers the opportunity to expand into broader marketing leadership responsibilities while continuing to build and scale a best-in-class performance marketing function.

title: FULL-CYCLE ACCOUNTANT — ONE COMPANY (FULL-TIME & LONG-TERM)
description:
FULL-CYCLE ACCOUNTANT — ONE COMPANY (FULL-TIME & LONG-TERM)



This is the entire set of books for one company, owned by one person. Not one slice of a process. Not one client out of six. The whole book, and you are the only one on it.



Most accounting jobs hand you a piece of someone else's work and someone else's judgment. This one hands you the whole thing.



This is a full-time role for someone who wants ONE company to commit to, not another client on a roster. If you are looking to add to a roster, this is not the role. If you want one secure, long-term seat where you become the person the numbers run through, keep reading.



ABOUT US



We are a Canadian company that supplies and builds out retail stores across Canada and the United States. We have grown quickly, and the books have grown with us. We are hiring one reliable, detail-oriented accountant to own the day-to-day finances for the long term.



HOW WE WORK



Two things matter here more than they did anywhere you have worked before.



First — we would rather you ask than guess. If something is unclear, you stop and you ask. Nobody here has ever been in trouble for asking a question and nobody ever will be. What does cause problems is a number that was assumed instead of verified.



Second — accuracy over speed. We do not need the fastest close. We need one that is right, that ties out, and that still holds up when a customer disputes it six months later.



If you are the kind of accountant who checks their own work before anyone asks for it, this seat was built for you. If you prefer to move fast and sort out the details later, it is not.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



You own AP and AR end to end. Nobody checks your work line by line, because you are the person who checks it.



• Own roughly 3,000 bank and credit card transactions a year, in CAD and USD

• Match incoming customer payments to the correct invoices in QuickBooks Online

• Create bills for supplier invoices and match outgoing payments to the correct bills

• Enter and code supplier bills, with proper supporting documentation

• Record customer deposits and progress payments against the correct project

• Maintain accounts receivable and accounts payable, including balances, due dates, and aging

• Track net-terms accounts, including invoice dates, shipment dates, and due dates

• Follow up on invoices approaching or past due

• Prepare supplier bills for payment approval

• Handle multi-currency correctly (CAD and USD)

• Reconcile payments against bank and payment records

• Track AP, AR, and account payment applications in Google Sheets

• Handle daily
 with customers on invoices and payment collection





The work is detailed and a lot of it is transactional. We will not pretend otherwise. What makes it different is that it is yours — you are not one of forty people each doing one step. You are the person whose number is the number.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



• A degree in accounting (BS Accountancy or equivalent). We want a real accounting foundation, not only short-course bookkeeping training

• 5 or more years of real full-cycle bookkeeping and accounting experience

• Strong, hands-on QuickBooks Online experience, or strong experience in a comparable system such as Xero or ERPs and the ability to pick up QuickBooks quickly if no prior experience is present

• Comfortable with multi-currency (CAD/USD, or any two currencies)

• Solid experience with accounts payable, accounts receivable, and reconciliations

• A stable work history. Someone who stays in roles long-term, not someone who changes jobs or clients constantly

• Excellent written and spoken English. You will be
ing our customers directly

• Most of all — reliable, careful, and trustworthy with sensitive financial work



WHAT YOU GET



• A raise every year you stay in this role. Your rate is reviewed at 12 months and it goes up. You will never have to leave to get paid more for the same work

• Generous increases when the role grows. As you take on more responsibility and bring more value to the company, the pay moves with it. We would far rather pay you more than replace you

• Real room to grow. This role expands over time into cash flow work, reporting, and our move onto a full ERP system. The person in this seat grows with the finance function rather than out of it

• Full-time and permanent. We are hiring one person for years, not for a project

• Schedule: at least half your day overlaps Eastern Time, roughly 8 AM to 1 PM ET. The rest of your hours are flexible

• Paid twice a month, tracked with time-tracking software



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please fill out our short application form.

title: Level 3 Senior Network Engineer (MSP) - Long Term, Work From Home
description:
We are a 13-person managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, hiring one senior engineer in the Philippines. Permanent, work-from-home, and we mean long-term - one of our engineers in India has been with us for 15 years and has flown out to visit us several times.



THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The engineer we are after is simple to describe: we can hand them anything, and they will solve it.



Not the person who knows every product - nobody does. The person who, when something breaks that they have never seen before:



- Finds out what is actually happening before touching anything. Reads the real error. Checks what changed. Does not randomly restart things and hope.

- Narrows it down on purpose, ruling things out one at a time instead of guessing.

- Owns it until it is finished. Does not hand a half-solved ticket back and say "still broken."

- Documents while the work is fresh. Everything we figure out goes into Hudu, our knowledge base, so the next engineer who hits that problem fixes it in ten minutes instead of three hours. The best engineers here are the ones whose write-ups everybody else relies on.

- Says "I don't know yet - here is how I will find out." We respect that more than a confident wrong answer.

- Knows the difference between "keep digging" and "ask for help now."

- Is genuinely curious. Takes the weird ticket because the weird ticket is interesting.



If you are the person your team quietly forwards the nightmare tickets to, we want to talk to you.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



This is not a guess. It is what our senior engineer in San Diego actually does, and it is the seat you would fill:



- 8:00 AM - 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams. Who is stuck, what is on fire.

- Then the escalations: tickets that already defeated someone else, where the obvious fix did not work.

- Underneath them there is almost always a project moving - a Microsoft 365 or Entra ID migration, a server replacement, a new firewall, a client leaving an old domain. You push it forward even on a busy day.

- Identity work constantly: Entra ID and Active Directory, conditional access, MFA that broke, onboarding and offboarding gone sideways.

- Networking: SonicWall, Sophos and Ubiquiti firewalls, dropped VPN tunnels, VLANs, DNS, switches.

- Servers: Windows Server, Hyper-V and VMware, Exchange, storage, backups that did not run.

- Security alerts to judge - real, or noise? Both answers cost you if you get them wrong.

- Writing up what you learned in Hudu before closing it out.

- Occasionally something breaks after hours and you are the person who can fix it.



No two days look the same. If you want to do the same three tasks forever, this is the wrong job.



WHAT WE RUN



ConnectWise, Kaseya, Microsoft 365 and Entra ID, Windows Server
, Active Directory, Exchange, Hyper-V and VMware, Sophos / SonicWall / Ubiquiti firewalls, L2 and L3 switching, VPNs, DNS, Synology NAS, Acronis, Dell servers and iDRAC, Windows 10 and 11, and Hudu.



You will not know all of it. You should know most of it and learn the rest fast.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other. Whoever we add has to fit that:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your technical opinion on how to fix something



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



This is a full night shift in the Philippines. You work US Pacific business hours:



- 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday.

- That is 11:00 PM to 8:00 AM Manila in the US summer, midnight to 9:00 AM in the US winter. Our clocks shift twice a year, yours do not.

- A 15-minute stand-up on Teams at 8:00 AM San Diego, on camera. After that you get your day to work - we do not sit on a video call all day.



We are not asking for a few hours of overlap. Your whole working day is our working day. Do not apply if that will make you miserable in six months - we are hiring for the next ten years.



ALSO IMPORTANT



- You need genuinely reliable internet and computer, plus a real backup plan when power or internet goes out.

- You must be comfortable on camera and on the phone with American clients. Your English must be very good - spoken, not just written.

- Log your time every day.



PAY



2,200 to 3,200 USD per month, based on real technical depth and English. We pay at the top of that range for the right person and do not haggle over a few dollars with someone we intend to keep for a decade.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Subject line, exactly this format:

L3 Engineer - [Your Name] - [the song you would put on while fixing a dead server at 2 AM]



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording - WAV or MP3 - reading these two questions out loud and then answering them:

- "Tell me about the hardest technical problem you ever solved, and how you figured it out."

- "What do you do when you are completely stuck?"

Two to three minutes is plenty. No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we do this so we do not waste your time or ours on a call that was never going to work.



4. One line: can you work 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a skills conversation on Microsoft Teams, 30 to 90 minutes.

Stage 3 - a hands-on test in a live environment, and we pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

title: Video Editor
description:
Hi — thanks for looking. Please read the whole post before applying; there are a few quick steps at the bottom, and we do skip applications that miss them.



We're a small video editing studio making long-form YouTube content for a handful of clients — our videos usually run 30–50 minutes. The work changes from client to client, so it stays interesting. Our lead editor handles the creative direction, and we're looking for one editor to take footage from raw into a strong edit alongside him.



This is a real editing role — cutting long-form footage into a story. It's not graphic design or thumbnail work. If you live in a Premiere timeline and know how to shape hours of raw into something that holds attention, you'll like it here. (After Effects on top of that is a nice bonus, not a requirement.)



**What the work looks like:**

- We hand you organized footage. You build the timeline and finish syncing the multicam — we have a tool that gets it most of the way, and you tighten it up.

- You watch through the raw and cut it into a strong, well-structured edit: what to keep, what to drop, how it should flow. This is the heart of the job.

- Captions, audio balancing, simple color, and clean delivery.



How far you take the edit is up to how good you are. Some editors will hand back a solid cut for our lead to finish; if you can take it all the way to a polished video, even better — there's real room to own more over time.



**What we're looking for:**

- You edit in Adobe Premiere Pro (2025/2026) — it's what we use, so it's a must.

- You can sync multicam footage yourself.

- Real story sense — you can structure an hour of footage without someone holding your hand.

- Reliable, clear communicator, and you hit your deadlines.

- Stable internet and a computer that handles 4K. On bigger projects we'll set you up with proxies; on smaller ones you'll work with the full files, so a solid connection and some storage matter.



**Nice to have:** After Effects skills, a feel for YouTube retention (why the first 15 seconds matter), and the kind of person who takes a note once and runs with it.



**The role:** it starts with a small paid trial edit so we can both feel out the fit. From there it's ongoing part-time (20 hrs/week) at $600 CAD/month to start, paid on time via Wise or PayPal — with real room to grow in hours, pay, and responsibility as we take on more work.



**To apply, just:**

1. Start your message with the word **FIRSTFRAME** so we know you read this.

2. Share 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you personally edited, and tell us what you did on each.

3. In a sentence or two: you're handed several hours of multicam footage for a 30–50 minute video — where do you start, and how do you keep something that long engaging?

4. Let us know your Premiere version, computer specs, and internet speed.

5. Your monthly rate and weekly availability.



We read every complete application and reply to the ones that feel like a fit. Thanks for taking the time — looking forward to seeing your work.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Frontend-leaning)
description:
About OutsideHire



Outside Hire is a growing outsourcing company with over 75 employees, building custom products and solutions for our clients. We're dynamic, fast-paced, and always evolving!







Why OutsideHire?



- An inclusive and dynamic work environment that values creativity and collaboration

- Opportunities to work on cutting-edge projects that make an impact

- Perks: Competitive salary, remote work, professional development support, etc.

- A team that truly values your skills and contributions



About the Role



You will own the payment SDK: the embeddable React layer that collects payment credentials inside isolated iframes, exchanges them for tokens, and routes transactions to the correct gateway based on server-issued session intent. This is not a role about building forms and CRUD screens. It is infrastructure that other engineers integrate against and that real money flows through, where a bug is not a broken layout but a failed transaction, a double charge, or a compliance i
. The work is front-end-heavy, but backend competence is a hard requirement. You cannot build a secure payment SDK without understanding what happens on the other side of the wire.



What You'll Be Building



- The SDK core. Hosted-fields integration with iframe isolation and cross-origin messaging, and a gateway-agnostic public API so integrators write one integration regardless of the processor behind it.

- The payment state model. Session intent so the client never d
 which gateway processes a transaction, plus idempotency, retries, declines, 3DS challenges, timeouts, and the partial states that need reconciliation.

- The integration surface. Versioning and deprecation policy so we can evolve without breaking live merchants, documentation and sandbox examples, and client-side observability on the payment step.



What We're Looking For



Required

- 7+ years building production software, with the majority of that time in frontend engineering

- Deep React and TypeScript. Not "I use React." You understand rendering behavior, state boundaries, effect lifecycles, memorization tradeoffs, and how to design a component API other engineers will consume

- Real backend capability. .NET, Java, or Node.js preferred. You can read and write server-side code, reason about API contracts you did not design, debug across the stack, and hold your own in an architecture discussion

- Security fundamentals as instinct. Same-origin policy, CSP, CORS, XSS vectors, iframe isolation, token handling, why secrets never live in client bundles

- Payment integration experience. Gateway APIs, tokenization, hosted fields, webhooks, or equivalent work in a domain where correctness is non-negotiable

- SDK or library authoring experience, or a track record of building interfaces other engineers integrate against

- Testing discipline. You write tests because untested payment code is a liability, not because a policy says to



Strong Plus

- Hands-on experience with gateway and tokenization stacks

- PCI DSS scope reduction, SAQ A or SAQ A-EP work

- 3D Secure 2 implementation

- Cloud and DevOps exposure (Azure or AWS), CI/CD ownership

- Fluency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot). We use them heavily. Willingness to learn fast is acceptable, resistance is not



How We Work



We move fast and requirements change. You will not get a fully specified ticket handed to you. You will get a problem, the business context behind it, and the autonomy to solve it.



- You ask the sharp question before writing code, not after shipping the wrong thing

- You escalate ambiguity early instead of guessing quietly

- You push back when an approach is wrong, with a better alternative

- You are comfortable working directly with product and client stakeholders

- You do not need to be managed into producing work you are proud of



If you have only worked in environments with detailed specs, dedicated QA, and long review cycles, you will find this uncomfortable. If you have worked in startups or fast-moving product teams, this will feel familiar.



The Bar



We are explicit about this because it saves everyone time.



We are hiring for craft. That means naming things well, keeping abstractions honest, deleting code that should not exist, reading the gateway documentation rather than guessing, and caring what the integration feels like for the engineer on the other side. We would rather ship one correct payment flow than five that mostly work.



If that sounds like unnecessary perfectionism, we are not a fit. If it sounds like how software should have been built all along, we want to talk.

title: Network Engineer (MSP) - Early Shift, Maintenance + Helpdesk, Work From Home
description:
We are a managed services provider (MSP) in San Diego, California, hiring 2 network engineers in the Philippines. Full-time, work-from-home, long-term. I have run this business for 30 years and I am the owner.



READ THIS FIRST SO YOU APPLY TO THE RIGHT JOB



This is NOT our senior engineer role. We have a separate post for a Level 3 Senior Network Engineer - if you are already a deep senior troubleshooter, apply to that one instead.



This role is for the engineer who is genuinely good today and wants to be trained into great. You will be trained by one of our senior engineers. There is a real path from this seat to the senior seat, and we would much rather promote you than hire a stranger later.



A DAY IN THE LIFE



This is not a guess. It is the work our US engineers do right now, and it is the seat you would fill.



5:00 AM to 8:00 AM San Diego (8:00 PM to 11:00 PM Manila) - THE QUIET HOURS. The maintenance queue in ConnectWise. Nobody is calling, nothing is on fire, and you work a list:



- Servers and workstations low on disk space. Find what is eating it, clean it up properly, note what you did.

- Patching that needs a second look, and reboots that never completed.

- Monitoring alerts to clear or escalate: an agent that stopped checking in, a service that keeps stopping.

- Backup jobs to verify. A backup nobody checked is not a backup.

- The recurring housekeeping that quietly keeps a lot of client systems healthy.



One of our engineers does almost exactly this full time today. It is the best way to learn every client we have before anybody depends on you live.



8:00 AM San Diego (11:00 PM Manila) - 15-minute stand-up on Microsoft Teams. You tell the team what you cleared overnight.



8:00 AM to 2:00 PM - HELPDESK. Live tickets with the rest of the team:



- Workstation problems: Windows 10 and 11, software that will not install, machines that crawl.

- Printers and scanners. Yes, really. Every MSP lives here.

- Outlook and Microsoft 365: mail flow, shared mailboxes, calendar permissions, licensing.

- New user setups, offboarding, password and MFA resets.

- Mapped drives, permissions, file access.

- Talking to real people who are frustrated and need you calm and clear.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO: go onsite. Anything physical - swapping hardware, running cable, standing in a server room - stays with our US engineers. Everything you do is remote.



WHAT WE USE



ConnectWise, Kaseya, Microsoft 365, Windows Server, Active Directory, backup tools, firewalls, Hudu for documentation, and more. You do not need to know all of it - know enough to be useful on day one and be eager to learn the rest.



THE PERSON WE WANT



- Reliable. If you say you will do something, it gets done.

- Teachable. You would rather be corrected than be right.

- Good with people. Most of our clients are not technical and are often frustrated when they reach us. How you make them feel matters as much as the fix.

- Organized. Maintenance work rewards someone who works a list properly instead of skipping around.

- Writes things down. Everything we learn goes into Hudu, our knowledge base, and you will lean on it constantly while learning our clients' systems. As you grow, you go from reading those articles to writing them. Helping the next engineer succeed is part of the job, not something extra.



ABOUT US



Completely virtual, and we genuinely like each other. Whoever we add has to fit that:



- Good vibes

- Hard working

- Customer caring

- Friendly

- Open to suggestions, easy communication

- Most of us really love music and chat about fun things on our Microsoft Teams board

- Willing to share your technical opinion on how to fix something



THE SCHEDULE - READ THIS TWICE



- 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM San Diego time, Monday to Friday.

- In Manila that is 8:00 PM to 5:00 AM in the US summer, 9:00 PM to 6:00 AM in the US winter. Our clocks shift twice a year, yours do not.

- You finish before sunrise and your whole Manila day is free.



Yes, this is a night shift in the Philippines. We are upfront about it because we are hiring for many years, not many weeks.



TALK TO OUR PHILIPPINE TEA
MBER BEFORE YOU D



We already have an employee in the Philippines who has been with us 3 to 4 years. Once we are far enough along, we will put you in touch with her privately so you can ask her anything about working for us. It is hard to judge a foreign employer from a job post - ask her instead of taking our word for it.



ALSO IMPORTANT



- Be on camera for the 15-minute stand-up at 8:00 AM San Diego, every working day.

- Log your time every day.

- You need extremely reliable internet and computer, plus a backup plan when power or internet goes out.

- Your English must be good, spoken as well as written, because you will talk to American clients.



PAY



1,400 to 2,200 USD per month, based on experience and English. As you grow into more senior work, your pay grows with it.



HOW TO APPLY - THIS IS PART OF THE TEST



1. Put "California Dreaming" in your subject line, along with your name.



2. Attach your resume.



3. Attach a voice recording - WAV or MP3 - reading this question out loud and then answering it:

"Tell me about a time you had to explain something technical to a frustrated customer who did not understand it. What did you say, and how did it end?"

Two to three minutes is plenty. No ZIP or RAR files. Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed - we do this so we do not waste your time or ours on a call that was never going to work.



4. One line: can you work 5:00 AM to 2:00 PM San Diego time, five days a week, long term? Yes or no.



OUR PROCESS



Stage 1 - these questions and your voice recording.

Stage 2 - a skills conversation on Microsoft Teams, 30 to 90 minutes.

Stage 3 - a hands-on test in a live environment, and we pay you for your time.



Thanks for reading all the way to the bottom : )

title: Software Engineer / AI-Assisted Full-Stack Developer
description:

Understand authentication, authorization, security, logging, error handling, and access control.

We do not expect every line of code to be written manually. We encourage the responsible use of AI development tools.

the architecture of the system;

the accuracy and security of the code;

testing and debugging;

database design;

maintainability and scalability;

technical documentation;

successful deployment and ongoing support.

Strong knowledge of at least one backend language and framework.

title: PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist
description:
We are looking for a PM Scheduler & Customer Retention Specialist to own our preventive maintenance pipeline and keep our technicians’ calendars full. This is a production scheduling role with real sales responsibility: you will prospect new PM customers, send and follow up on PM proposals until they sign, schedule all PM and warranty work, and keep existing PM accounts happy.



You will work closely with our Customer Service Admin, who handles the main phone line, collections, repair invoices, and simple bookings when parts are already onsite. You take everything they hand off — PM leads, warranty jobs, and repairs that need parts ordered — and you own the calendar from there.



This is not a generic receptionist job. Success here means a full tech calendar (~1 week booked ahead), PM contracts signed, and PM customers retained.



What you will do every day

PM sales & retention



Identify and pursue new PM prospects: gyms, hotels, HOAs, property managers, and commercial facilities

Work warm leads handed off from Customer Service (PM LEAD packets)

Send PM contract proposals via
 and follow up persistently until the customer signs or clearly declines (target: touch every open quote at least every 5 business days)

Proactive outreach to existing PM accounts — resolve issues before contracts churn

Scheduling & calendar management



Schedule all preventive maintenance visits for signed PM contracts (commercial + residential)

Keep technicians booked ~1 week ahead — never let the calendar drop below ~3 business days of work unless intentionally left open

Schedule warranty jobs within each manufacturer’s expected timeline

Schedule parts repair jobs when parts are ordered, in transit, or marked ready in Trello (Parts Admin workflow)

Process HANDOFF packets from Customer Service — book in ServiceMinder same day (urgent) or within 24 hours (routine)

Daily workflow



Review open PM proposals due for follow-up today

Check ServiceMinder calendar density per technician

Monitor Trello Parts Admin for Phase 5 overdue cards and parts-ready jobs

Work PM compliance list for overdue commercial PM visits

Process warranty queue

Return PM retention calls/messages from the prior day

What this role is NOT

Not the primary answer on the main customer service phone line (Customer Service Admin owns that)

Not responsible for unpaid invoice follow-up or sending repair invoices

Not responsible for repair/diagnostic proposals (those are Customer Service)

Not booking simple diagnostic/repair visits when parts are already at the customer’s site (Customer Service books those)

Clear handoffs between the two roles are documented — you will know exactly what is yours vs. what gets handed off.



Tools you will use

ServiceMinder (primary — scheduling, PM proposals, customer records)

Google Sheets (PM schedule planning calendar)

Trello (Parts Admin cards, commercial PM funnel)

Gmail (PM proposals and scheduling confirmations)

RingCentral (PM prospect and retention calls — backup on main line when needed)

WhatsApp (scheduler/tech coordination)

Warranty manufacturer portals (training provided)



How we measure success

Metric Target

Tech calendar lookahead

?3 business days booked; target ~1 week

PM proposal sent after qualified lead

Within 2 business days

PM proposal follow-up

Every 5 business days on open quotes

HANDOFF ? appointment booked

Same day (urgent) / 24h (routine)

Parts ready ? job scheduled

Within 48 business hours

PM retention issues

Acknowledge same day; resolve or escalate within 48h

Trello Phase 5 cards

Nothing silently aging past 48 hours

Weekly performance review with the owner. Metrics are tracked — this role has clear accountability.



Ideal candidate

Calendar thinker — you naturally plan ahead and hate empty technician days

Comfortable with outbound sales — PM prospecting and polite persistence on proposals without being pushy

Organized follow-up machine — you don’t let open quotes or HANDOFF packets sit

Field service or commercial PM experience a strong plus — gyms, hotels, property management, HVAC-style recurring service

Professional phone and
 communication

Comfortable learning ServiceMinder, Trello, and warranty portals quickly

Self-directed — you manage your own daily queue without being micromanaged

Accepts documented KPIs and weekly review

title: Video Editor Finance and Tax Education Channel
description:
I am a certified public accountant based in Austin, Texas, producing educational videos on tax planning and personal finance. I am looking for a skilled video editor to turn my raw footage and scripts into polished, engaging videos for YouTube. This is a fully remote, home-based role open to editors in the Philippines. I plan to publish on a regular schedule, starting part-time or per video, with room to grow as the channel expands.



What you will do



Edit long-form talking-head videos: tighten pacing, cut filler and dead air, and hold viewer attention from start to finish

Add b-roll, screen recordings, stock footage, and sound effects that reinforce the script

Build clean on-screen graphics and animated text to explain financial concepts, including charts, tables, and simple diagrams

Create lower thirds, callouts, and captions or subtitles

Balance audio, reduce background noise, and apply color correction

Organize project files and deliver on agreed deadlines
