Proficiency in a professional editing tool such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or Final Cut Pro

A strong sense of pacing and storytelling built around viewer retention

Ability to produce readable, professional on-screen text and graphics; comfort visualizing numbers and data is a real advantage given the subject matter

Strong English comprehension, since scripts cover technical financial topics and text must be placed accurately

Reliable high-speed internet, a capable computer, and dependable availability

Willingness to take direction, apply feedback, and meet deadlines consistently



Nice to have



Motion graphics skills in Adobe After Effects

Thumbnail design

Experience editing finance, business, or educational channels

Familiarity with what drives YouTube watch time and retention



Details



Setup: fully remote, work from home

Type: part-time or per-project to start, with potential to scale up

Schedule: flexible and mostly asynchronous. I provide footage, scripts, and a clear brief for each video

Compensation: [state your rate here, per video or per hour]



How to apply

Send your portfolio or demo reel along with a short note covering your editing software, any experience with educational or finance content, and your current availability. Applications without a portfolio or reel will not be considered.

title: Sales Representative
description:
Join a fast-growing US online home goods retailer and enjoy the learning and opportunities that you have while working with us.



We strive to provide 5-star service & shopping assistance to all of our clients, and all of our team is accountable to fulfill this.



We are looking for a Sales Representative who can assist prospective buyers and close online ecommerce sales.



We're only looking for full-time, long-term, ongoing cooperation.



Work schedules available:

8 AM to 4 PM US EST

4 PM to 12 AM US EST



Your work week will be 5 days per week, with 2 days off per week. Days off will be selected with your manager. We will try to accommodate your preferences for which days you like, based on availability.



This role starts ASAP!!



Job Duties and Responsibilities:

Receive incoming phone calls and live chats from potential customers (prospects) who indicated that they need shopping assistance. This does not include calls and chats from existing customers that need help with their orders (that’s a job for a different department)

Makes follow-up calls, writes follow-up
s, and text messages to potential buyers. We try to follow up 5x with each person that contacted us (unless they indicate that they are no longer interested). We don’t do cold calling. Only reaching out to prospects who interacted with our online store and left their contact information.

After each interaction with a prospect/customer, writes notes & comments in our CRM (Asana)

Communicate efficiently and build rapport with potential customers

Assists prospects in their shopping journey and helps make the purchase decision

Ensures that all prospects’ questions and objections are addressed

Leads every interaction to a close sale, which means an order is placed on our online store

Prepares custom quotes, price matches competitors if necessary, and offers custom discounts. This requires calculating margins & ensuring profitability.

Answering questions about the products we offer, including technical questions. Learns the specifications, features and benefits of our bestsellers. Over time, becomes an expert in the industry.

If not able to answer product-specific questions, conducts research in the materials provided by the supplier, or reaches out to the supplier to get the information

Confirms stock availability and lead times when offering products to prospects

Documents standard procedures and best practices in a written form, so that other tea
mbers can learn from them



Requirements:

At least 2 years of experience in sales on the phone

Experience must include both inbound and outbound sales

Excellent written and verbal English communication skills

Experience in Customer Service on the phone is a nice to have

Experience in the e-commerce (online shopping) industry is nice to have

Home improvement, construction, and gas plumbing industry experience is a plus

Outgoing, friendly, and lively

Can-do mindset, with a sense of ownership, pride in your performance, and its impact on the company’s success

Long-term commitment - treat this as your career



What we can offer:

Sales commission: 12% of gross profit from all orders closed. Gross profit means the sale amount minus the product and shipping costs. Paid monthly. No upper limit. Monthly commission payouts range between $1,200 (the guaranteed minimum) and as high as $3,000 (for the top performer). The average monthly payout is $1,465 (average from the last 2 years).

$1,200/month minimum guaranteed pay

15 days paid days off per year (also convertible to min. guaranteed commission)

Paid training on all aspects of the role

Opportunities for professional development

Friendly atmosphere

Online Interview process

Fully remote position

 address]. We'd love to hear about your experience and what excites you about working with hospitality clients.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
You've worked in client service, account management, or customer retention. You’re good at keeping your accounts and clients are happy to continue working with you. You’re ready for something more now - a role where you can be a trusted advisor who makes a real difference.



You’ll join Performia Australia, part of a global Swedish HR consultancy operating in 26 countries. Our mission is to train and support business owners so they know how to identify and build productive, safe and fun teams.



Your mission is to guide our “Journey” clients through that process. You’ll be their partner, coach, and mentor. You’ll establish new clients, troubleshoot their hiring processes, and help them implement the Performia methodology. You’ll ensure they get the results they signed up for: hiring the right people and building a high-performing team.



We have a growing base of clients who have signed up for the Journey. They need hands-on support to implement the system. We need you to take full ownership of a client portfolio, proactively check in with them, and guide them to success.



The role will be challenging and requires responsibility. You will be depended on. You need to be able to take initiative and be accountable for your clients' progress. You need to be comfortable working independently and troubleshooting problems without hand-holding.



In return, you’ll receive full training on the Performia methodology and the HR industry. You’ll have the opportunity to build a professional career with a global company. You’ll work from home with a flexible, cheerful, and outcome-focused team.



You’ll be working for the Australian office, servicing the Australian clients. Even though you’ll work from home, you will have plenty of interaction every day with the rest of the team based in Australia, Philippines and China.



If you are someone who cannot work independently and you need to be around people all the time, then this role will not be right for you.



If you're ready for a role with real responsibility, you love to help others succeed, and you're looking for your chance to prove yourself and grow, apply now.

We will only consider candidates who submit their application to our candidate management system.

title: Facebook Post Copywriter For US Home Service Businesses
description:
We run a US marketing agency that writes
 posts for local home service businesses like painters, landscapers, and floor coating companies. The posts are published in local community
 groups, written in first person as the business owner. They open with the owner's real story and family, then the business, then a soft call to action. They must read like the owner typed them himself on his phone. Warm, plainspoken, zero marketing polish.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



You'll receive a written brief for each batch: the owner's real story details, example posts that performed well, and structure references. You write batches of posts (typically 30 to 90 at a time) where each post enters the story from a different angle with a different hook. Structural variety matters more than anything. We do not want the same post with words swapped.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



Ghostwriting experience, meaning you can write in someone else's voice, not your own

Story-based or direct response copy background

Strong conversational English. Your posts need to sound like a US tradesman, not a marketer.

Reliable turnaround on deadlines, 3 to 5 days per batch

If you use AI tools, that's fine, but the final text cannot read as AI written. You edit heavily and own the output.



HOW IT WORKS



We can structure pay as per-batch freelance work where you're paid a flat rate per post on delivery. Work volume grows as we add clients. Everything runs through written briefs and messages, no meetings required.



We can also do hourly/salary. Starting hours ~20/week with growth to 40 hours/week over a 1 month onboarding phase.



TO APPLY



Start your application with the word NEIGHBOR so I know you read this. Include 2 to 3 writing samples, ideally social media or ghostwritten content, and your rate per post.



First step for shortlisted applicants is a small paid test batch: 10 posts for $25.

title: Sales Support & CRM Administrator (Pipedrive + Xero)
description:
About us



We are The Stonemen, a natural stone supplier based in Brisbane, Australia. We sell marble, travertine and limestone to builders, landscapers and renovators. We are a small team and we are growing.



Australia is only two hours ahead of the Philippines, so you will be working the same hours as us, not overnight.



The role in one sentence



You will get our Pipedrive CRM set up properly, then run the quoting, invoicing and follow-up work inside it — so that our salespeople can spend their time selling instead of doing paperwork.



This is a real, long-term role. It is not a short project.



Your first few weeks: getting Pipedrive right



This part is critical to us, and it is why we want someone with real CRM experience rather than a general admin assistant.



We have started building our Pipedrive ourselves. It works, but we are not CRM experts and we know some of it is wrong. Before we bring our sales team on and import our customer list, we want someone who has done this before to go through it properly.



You will:



Audit what we have built — our pipelines, stages, custom fields, automations, filters, reports and user permissions — and tell us plainly what is wrong, missing or going to cause problems later

Fix it, once we have agreed the changes

Import our data — our full customer list, our product list, and our open quotes — cleanly and without duplicates

Build simple training material for our sales team, in plain English. None of them have used a CRM before, so clear beats clever

Set up the reports our management team needs to review the sales pipeline each week



We want your opinion here, not just your hands. If we have designed something badly, say so. We would much rather hear it now than in six months.



What you will do day to day, after that



Quotes



Take job details from our salespeople and build the quote in Pipedrive (our CRM)

Check the stock and pricing information we give you, and ask when something does not look right

Send the quote out through Xero (our accounting system)

Record the date it was sent and schedule the follow-ups



Follow-up



Send follow-up
s to customers on a set schedule

Remind our salespeople when they owe a customer a phone call

Keep the record of what has happened on every job up to date



Invoices



Raise invoices in Xero once a sale is confirmed

Follow up customers who have not paid



Purchase orders



Prepare purchase orders to our Australian suppliers, for approval before they are sent

(Overseas orders are handled by our team in Australia, not by you)



Keeping the CRM clean



Make sure every deal has the information it needs: a contact person, a value, a decision date and a next step

Chase our salespeople when something is missing

Flag jobs that have gone quiet



Improving the system over time



Keep improving how Pipedrive is set up as we learn what works and what does not

Build automations that remove repetitive manual steps, once a process has settled down and proven itself

Suggest better ways of doing things — we expect the setup in month twelve to look different from month one



Later on, once you are settled, the role may grow to include other administrative support for our business. We will talk about that when we get there.



To be clear about what this role is not: we are not looking for someone to manage calendars or
 inboxes, and this is not a lead generation, cold calling or social media role.



What we need from you



Essential



You have set up or reconfigured a CRM before, not only used one. Pipedrive is ideal, but HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce or similar is fine. Tell us what you built and what decisions you made

Experience importing and cleaning data — customer lists, product lists, duplicates

Experience creating quotes or invoices in an accounting system. Xero is ideal, but QuickBooks, MYOB or similar is fine

Very good written English — you will be
ing our Australian customers directly

Strong attention to detail. Our quotes contain prices, quantities and measurements, and a small mistake costs us real money

Comfortable working through the same list of tasks every day and not letting anything slip

Reliable internet and a quiet place to work



Nice to have



Experience working with an Australian business

Experience in construction, building supplies, or a product-based business

Understanding of purchase orders and stock



Most important of all: we need someone who tells us when something looks wrong instead of guessing. If a price does not match, or a customer's request does not make sense, we want you to ask. We will never be annoyed at you for asking.



What we offer

- A clear, well-documented process — you will not be left to figure it out alone

- Direct working relationship with the business owner, not layers of management

- Long-term, stable work with a growing company

- Regular hours that match your own timezone

- Training on our systems in your first weeks

- How to apply



Please send us a message that includes:



- Start your message with the word TRAVERTINE so we know you read the whole ad.

- Which CRM you have used, and for how long. If you have set one up or reconfigured one, describe what you built and one decision you made that you think was a good one.

- Which accounting system you have used to create quotes or invoices, and roughly how many you would produce in a typical week.

- A short description of a time you spotted a mistake in someone else's work before it went out to a customer.

- Your expected monthly salary in PHP.



Applications that do not follow these steps will not be read.



We will reply to shortlisted applicants within 10 days. There will be a short paid test task before we make any offer, we would rather see your work than guess from a CV.



Thank you for reading, and we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Recruitment Admin
description:
Recruitment Admin / Back Office Support - Australian Labour Hire Agency



Type: Part-time (25 hours per week, with a path to more hours) Salary: AUD $400 - $650 per month, depending on experience Schedule: Monday to Friday, 5 hours per day, overlapping Sydney business hours (Manila time 6:00am - 11:00am, flexible for the right person) Location: Remote, Philippines



About us



Forgepoint Recruitment is a Sydney-based labour hire agency placing tradespeople and industrial workers with manufacturers and construction businesses across Australia. We are small, growing fast, and this is our first offshore hire.



You would be working directly with the founder. There is no layer of management between you and the person making decisions, which means fast answers, direct feedback, and real ownership of your work.



What you will be doing



This is a back office role. You keep the engine running so the front of the business can keep placing people.



Timesheet and payroll support



Chase workers for missing timesheets each week using our
 and SMS templates

Track who has submitted and who has not, and escalate anything outstanding before Monday 10:00am Sydney time

Flag discrepancies between submitted hours and expected hours



Invoicing support (preparation only)



Prepare draft invoices in our timesheet system (Karmly) ready for review

Cross-check invoice line items against approved timesheets and rate cards

Note: you will never send invoices or handle payments. Preparation only.



Candidate document management



Format candidate CVs into our branded submission template (Microsoft Word)

Collect and file compliance documents from candidates - licences, tickets, tax and super forms

Conduct written reference checks by
 using our templates



Recruitment admin



Post and refresh job ads across job boards

Keep our applicant tracking system (JobAdder) clean and up to date - deduplicate records, update statuses, tag candidates correctly

Maintain candidate and client records in SharePoint



Growing into (once established)



Bank reconciliation preparation

Drafting confirmation of assignment documents

Onboarding pack administration

What you will NOT be doing



Being upfront so there are no surprises:



No phone calls with clients or candidates - this role is written communication only

No payroll processing, no sending invoices, no handling of money or banking

No cold calling or sales

What we are looking for



Essential



At least 2 years in an admin, virtual assistant, or back office support role

Excellent written English - you will be sending
s to Australian workers and drafting documents

Strong Microsoft Word and Excel skills (formatting documents properly, working with spreadsheets)

Genuinely detail-focused - this role involves numbers, dates and names where small mistakes cost real money

Reliable internet and a quiet place to work

Able to work the stated hours consistently



Highly desirable



Experience with recruitment, staffing, or HR admin

Experience with an applicant tracking system (JobAdder, Bullhorn, JobDiva or similar)

Experience with timesheet or invoicing software

Experience working with Australian or other Western clients



What matters most to us



You follow through without being chased

You flag problems early rather than hiding them

You ask questions when something is unclear instead of guessing

You are looking for a long-term role, not a stopgap

What we offer

Stable, ongoing work with a growing business

Direct access to the business owner, and real say in how processes get built

Written processes and templates for everything - you will not be left guessing

Paid training period while you learn our systems

Genuine path to more hours and increased pay as the business grows

13th month pay

How to apply



Please read this part carefully, because we do read every application properly.



Send your application with the subject line: Recruitment Admin - [Your Name] - Sydney



In your message, answer these three questions:



Describe a time you spotted a mistake in someone else's work before it caused a problem. What did you do?

What admin or back office tasks do you find most satisfying, and why?

What are your internet speed and your available working hours in Manila time?



Please also attach your CV and let us know your expected monthly rate in AUD.



Applications that do not answer the three questions will not be reviewed.



Only successful applicants will be contacted.
